#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Project-local ontology: read, validate, explicitly build, freeze or publish."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True

from ontology_core import OntologyError, load_project, read_json, safe_path, sha256, require
from ontology_retrieval import human, read, search, term


def health(root, *, scope="selected", level="static", required=()):
    from ontology_health import aggregate, PRODUCTS
    require(set(required) <= PRODUCTS, "invalid_assessment", "Unknown required generated component.")
    try:
        p = load_project(root, validate=False)
        from ontology_validate import validate_project
        validation = validate_project(p)
        projections = {}
        for operation in ("compile", "build-wiki", "link-memory"):
            path = f".sys4ai/ontology/manifests/{operation}.json"
            manifest = safe_path(p.root, path, must_exist=False)
            if not manifest.exists():
                projections[operation] = {"status": "missing", "explicit_operation": operation}
                continue
            try:
                value = read_json(manifest)
                require(isinstance(value, dict) and isinstance(value.get("outputs"), dict) and isinstance(value.get("context"), dict), "invalid_manifest", "Generated ownership manifest is malformed.", path=path)
                if operation == "build-wiki":
                    from ontology_wiki import filename
                    expected_outputs = {"ONTOLOGY/WIKI/" + name for name in ("INDEX.md", "concepts.md", "relationships.md", "modules.md", "capabilities.md")}
                    expected_outputs.update("ONTOLOGY/WIKI/" + filename(r["@id"]) for r in p.records)
                else:
                    expected_outputs = {"compile": {".sys4ai/ontology/compiled/graph.json", ".sys4ai/ontology/compiled/index.json"},
                                        "link-memory": {".sys4ai/ontology/links/memory-records.json"}}[operation]
                same_inputs = value["context"].get("snapshot_sha256") == p.context()["snapshot_sha256"]
                require(value.get("schema_version") == 1 and value.get("operation") == operation and value["outputs"] and
                        (not same_inputs or set(value["outputs"]) == expected_outputs),
                        "invalid_manifest", "Generated manifest must name the complete expected output set for its operation.", path=path)
                state = "current" if same_inputs else "stale"
                for output, digest in value["outputs"].items():
                    require(isinstance(output, str) and output.startswith((".sys4ai/ontology/", "ONTOLOGY/WIKI/")) and isinstance(digest, str), "invalid_manifest", "Generated manifest contains an unsafe output reference.")
                    target = safe_path(p.root, output, must_exist=False)
                    if not target.exists() or sha256(target) != digest:
                        state = "stale"
                projections[operation] = {"status": state, "manifest": path, "explicit_operation": operation}
            except OntologyError as error:
                projections[operation] = {"status": "invalid", "error": error.as_dict()}
        canonical_ready = validation["valid"] and all(s["status"] == "current" for s in p.sources)
        components = {"canonical": {"required": True, "ready": canonical_ready}}
        for name, detail in projections.items():
            # A manifest establishes prior selection even after its outputs disappear.
            selected = detail["status"] != "missing"
            output = {"compile": ".sys4ai/ontology/compiled", "build-wiki": "ONTOLOGY/WIKI",
                      "link-memory": ".sys4ai/ontology/links/memory-records.json"}[name]
            selected = selected or safe_path(p.root, output, must_exist=False).exists()
            if name == "link-memory" and detail["status"] == "current":
                from ontology_memory import read_links
                try:
                    links = read_links(p)
                    detail.update(status=links["status"], dependency_details=links.get("limitations", []))
                except OntologyError as error:
                    detail.update(status="invalid", error=error.as_dict())
            needed = name in required or (scope == "selected" and selected)
            detail.update(required=needed, selected=selected)
            components[name] = {"required": needed, "ready": detail["status"] == "current", "status": detail["status"],
                                "next_operation": None if detail["status"] == "current" else name}
        return aggregate({"operation": "health", "canonical_ready": canonical_ready,
                "project_id": p.project_id, "configuration": "configured", "modules": "integrity_verified",
                "validation": validation, "sources": p.sources, "generated": projections,
                "project_extension": "empty" if not any(r["module"] == "project" for r in p.records) else "present",
                "context": p.context(), "mutated": False}, root, scope, level, components, p.context())
    except OntologyError as error:
        return aggregate({"operation": "health", "status": "absent" if not Path(root, "ontology.yaml").exists() else "invalid", "mutated": False, "error": error.as_dict()},
                         root, scope, level, {"canonical": {"required": True, "ready": False}})


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--project-root", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--format", choices=("json", "text"), default="json")
    parser.add_argument("--packet-file")
    parser.add_argument("--packet-sha256")
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    from ontology_health import arguments as health_arguments
    health_arguments(commands.add_parser("health"))
    commands.add_parser("validate")
    for operation in ("term", "search", "read", "capability", "knowledge", "neighbors", "path"):
        command = commands.add_parser(operation)
        command.add_argument("query")
        command.add_argument("--limit", type=int)
        command.add_argument("--max-bytes", type=int)
        if operation in {"neighbors", "path", "knowledge"}:
            command.add_argument("--hops", type=int)
            command.add_argument("--direction", choices=("incoming", "outgoing", "both"), default="outgoing" if operation == "path" else "both")
            command.add_argument("--predicate", action="append", default=[])
        if operation == "path":
            command.add_argument("target")
        if operation == "knowledge":
            command.add_argument("--intent", choices=("definition", "relationship", "capability", "current", "history", "mixed", "inference", "proposals"), default="mixed")
            command.add_argument("--advanced", action="store_true")
            command.add_argument("--memory-packet-file")
            command.add_argument("--memory-packet-sha256")
    commands.add_parser("compile")
    commands.add_parser("build-wiki")
    link = commands.add_parser("link-memory")
    link.add_argument("--record", action="append", default=[])
    link.add_argument("--concept", action="append", default=[])
    freeze = commands.add_parser("freeze-packet")
    freeze.add_argument("payload", help="JSON packet selection and exact current manager/execution inputs.")
    freeze.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    for operation in ("preview", "publish"):
        command = commands.add_parser(operation)
        command.add_argument("proposal")
        if operation == "publish":
            command.add_argument("--grant-file", required=True)
            command.add_argument("--expected-preview-sha256", required=True)
    recover = commands.add_parser("recover")
    recover.add_argument("operation_id")
    recover.add_argument("--grant-file", required=True)
    from ontology_advanced_cli import register, COMMANDS as ADVANCED_COMMANDS, READ_COMMANDS as ADVANCED_READS
    register(commands)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        root = Path(args.project_root).absolute()
        require(root.is_dir() and root.resolve() == root and not root.is_symlink(), "invalid_root", "Select an explicit resolved project root.")
        require(bool(args.packet_file) == bool(args.packet_sha256), "packet_reference", "Frozen queries require both packet path and SHA256.")
        frozen = bool(args.packet_file)
        if frozen:
            require(args.command in {"term", "search", "read", "neighbors", "path", "capability", "knowledge"}, "frozen_operation", "Frozen packets support only selected query operations.")
            from ontology_packet import frozen_project
            p = frozen_project(root, {"path": args.packet_file, "sha256": args.packet_sha256})
        elif args.command in {"term", "search", "read", "neighbors", "path", "capability", "knowledge", "compile", "build-wiki", "link-memory"}:
            p = load_project(root)
        if args.command in ADVANCED_COMMANDS:
            from ontology_advanced_cli import dispatch
            result = dispatch(root, args)
        elif args.command == "health": result = health(root, scope=args.scope, level=args.level, required=args.require)
        elif args.command == "validate":
            from check_ontology import run_checks
            result = run_checks(root)
        elif args.command in {"term", "search"}:
            result = {"term": term, "search": search}[args.command](p, args.query, limit=args.limit, max_bytes=args.max_bytes)
        elif args.command == "read": result = read(p, args.query, max_bytes=args.max_bytes)
        elif args.command in {"neighbors", "path"}:
            from ontology_graph import neighbors, path
            kwargs = dict(hops=args.hops, direction=args.direction, predicates=args.predicate, limit=args.limit, max_bytes=args.max_bytes)
            result = neighbors(p, args.query, **kwargs) if args.command == "neighbors" else path(p, args.query, args.target, **kwargs)
        elif args.command == "capability":
            from ontology_knowledge import capability
            result = capability(p, args.query, limit=args.limit, max_bytes=args.max_bytes)
        elif args.command == "knowledge":
            from ontology_knowledge import knowledge
            require(bool(args.memory_packet_file) == bool(args.memory_packet_sha256), "packet_reference", "Frozen memory requires an exact path and SHA256.")
            memory_ref = {"path": args.memory_packet_file, "sha256": args.memory_packet_sha256} if args.memory_packet_file else None
            result = knowledge(p, args.query, intent=args.intent, hops=args.hops, direction=args.direction, predicates=args.predicate,
                               memory_packet=memory_ref, frozen_ontology=frozen, limit=args.limit, max_bytes=args.max_bytes, advanced=args.advanced)
        elif args.command == "compile":
            from ontology_build import compile_project
            result = compile_project(p)
        elif args.command == "build-wiki":
            from ontology_wiki import build_wiki
            result = build_wiki(p)
        elif args.command == "link-memory":
            from ontology_memory import link_memory
            result = link_memory(p, record_paths=args.record, concept_queries=args.concept)
        elif args.command == "freeze-packet":
            from ontology_packet import build_packet, freeze_packet
            payload = read_json(safe_path(root, args.payload))
            require(isinstance(payload, dict) and {"task_path", "execution_id", "generation", "actor"} <= set(payload)
                    <= {"task_path", "execution_id", "generation", "actor", "concept_ids", "query", "allowed_sources", "max_records", "max_bytes", "subtask_id", "revision_reason", "advanced", "graph_selection", "inference_goals", "extension_ids", "semantic_queries"},
                    "invalid_packet_request", "Packet request requires current Task manager inputs and supported selection fields.")
            packet = build_packet(root, **payload)
            result = freeze_packet(root, packet, args.output, actor=payload["actor"])
        elif args.command == "preview":
            from ontology_publication import preview
            result = preview(root, read_json(safe_path(root, args.proposal)))
        elif args.command == "publish":
            from ontology_publication import publish
            result = publish(root, read_json(safe_path(root, args.proposal)), read_json(safe_path(root, args.grant_file)), expected_preview_sha256=args.expected_preview_sha256)
        else:
            from ontology_publication import recover
            result = recover(root, args.operation_id, read_json(safe_path(root, args.grant_file)))
        print(human(result) if args.format == "text" else json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2))
        if args.command in {"health", "advanced-health"}:
            return 0 if result.get("ready") else 2 if result.get("status") == "invalid" else 1
        return 1 if result.get("valid") is False or result.get("complete") is False or result.get("status") in {"invalid", "partial", "failed", "violation", "rejected"} else 0
    except OntologyError as error:
        read_only = args.command in {"health", "term", "search", "read", "neighbors", "path", "validate", "capability", "knowledge", "preview"} | ADVANCED_READS
        print(json.dumps({"status": "invalid", "error": error.as_dict(), "mutated": False if read_only else None}, sort_keys=True, indent=2))
        return 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Explicit optional setup and read-only readiness; no provisioning on reads."""
from pathlib import Path
import json
import os
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
from ontology_core import OntologyError, canonical_bytes, decode_json, read_bytes, require, safe_path, sha256
from ontology_advanced import load_advanced
from ontology_limits import limits
from ontology_worker import run_worker

PACKAGE=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
ENV='.venv-ontology-standards'
CERT=ENV+'/certification.json'
WORKER_FILES=('ontology_core.py','ontology_limits.py','ontology_advanced.py','ontology_worker.py',
 'ontology_backend.py','ontology_rdf.py','ontology_provenance.py','ontology_sparql.py',
 'ontology_interchange.py','ontology_reasoning.py','ontology_derivations.py','ontology_shacl.py')
ONTOLOGY_GUARDED_ACTIONS = ['configure_profile']


def fingerprint(root):
    manifest=decode_json(read_bytes(PACKAGE/'profiles/standards-v1.json'))
    env=Path(root)/ENV
    site=env/'lib/python3.12/site-packages'
    require(site.is_dir() and not env.is_symlink() and not site.is_symlink(),'backend_unavailable','The selected standards environment is absent or aliased.')
    files={}
    for item in manifest['packages']:
        name=item['name'].replace('-','_')
        matches=list(site.glob(name+'-'+item['version']+'.dist-info'))
        require(len(matches)==1,'backend_incompatible','Locked package metadata is absent: '+item['name'])
        for folder in [site/name,matches[0]]:
            require(folder.is_dir() and not folder.is_symlink(),'backend_incompatible','Locked package directory is unavailable.')
            for path in sorted(folder.rglob('*')):
                if path.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in path.parts and path.suffix not in {'.pyc','.pyo'}:
                    require(not path.is_symlink(),'backend_incompatible','Package file symlinks are outside the locked profile.')
                    files[str(path.relative_to(site))]=sha256(path.read_bytes())
    return {'schema_version':1,'profile_sha256':sha256(PACKAGE/'profiles/standards-v1.json'),
        'lock_sha256':sha256(PACKAGE/'requirements-standards.txt'),
        'worker_files':{name:sha256(PACKAGE/'scripts'/name) for name in WORKER_FILES},
        'installed_files_sha256':sha256(canonical_bytes(files)),'python_executable_sha256':sha256((env/'bin/python').resolve().read_bytes()),
        'packages':{p['name']:p['version'] for p in manifest['packages']}}


def health(root,profile='standards'):
    try:
        import platform
        cfg=load_advanced(root)
        runtime=Path(root)/('.venv-ontology-semantic' if profile=='semantic' else ENV)
        presence=(runtime/'bin/python').is_file()
        if cfg is None: return {'status':'absent','implemented':True,'installed':'not_assessed' if presence else False,'runtime_present':presence,'enabled':False,'validated':False,'profile':profile}
        selection=cfg['profiles'].get(profile,{})
        if not selection.get('enabled',False): return {'status':'disabled','implemented':True,'installed':'not_assessed' if presence else False,'runtime_present':presence,'enabled':False,'validated':False,'profile':profile}
        if profile=='inference' and not cfg['profiles'].get('standards',{}).get('enabled',False):
            return {'status':'dependency_disabled','enabled':True,'validated':False,'profile':profile}
        if profile=='semantic':
            from ontology_semantic import health as semantic_health
            return semantic_health(root)
        require(profile in {'standards','inference'},'unsupported_profile','Unknown optional backend profile.')
        require(platform.system()=='Darwin' and Path('/usr/bin/sandbox-exec').is_file(),'confinement_unavailable','This standards profile has no verified confinement on the current host.')
        observed=fingerprint(root)
        certificate_path=cfg['profiles'].get('standards',{}).get('certification',CERT)
        path=safe_path(root,certificate_path,must_exist=False)
        if not path.exists(): return {'status':'uncertified','implemented':True,'installed':True,'enabled':True,'validated':False,'profile':profile,'fingerprint':observed}
        cert=decode_json(read_bytes(path))
        valid=(cert.get('fingerprint')==observed and cert.get('status')=='validated' and
               cert.get('platform')=='Darwin' and all(cert.get('checks',{}).get(k) is True for k in ('file_denied','network_denied','parser_file_denied','parser_network_denied','memory_terminated','timeout_terminated','cancelled','malformed_ipc','worker_failure','output_bounded')))
        return {'status':'ready' if valid else 'incompatible_certification','implemented':True,'installed':True,
            'enabled':True,'validated':valid,'profile':profile,'versions':cert.get('versions'),
            'fingerprint':observed,'certification_sha256':sha256(path),'guarded':False}
    except OntologyError as exc:
        return {'status':exc.code,'implemented':True,'enabled':True,'validated':False,'profile':profile,'diagnostics':[exc.as_dict()]}


def certify(root):
    import platform
    python=Path(root)/ENV/'bin/python'; bound=limits()
    for index in range(2):
        slot=Path(root)/ENV/('worker-slot-'+str(index))
        if not slot.exists():
            fd=os.open(slot,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600); os.close(fd)
    actual=run_worker(python,'versions',{},bound)
    require(actual.get('status')=='ok','backend_unavailable','Actual locked backend imports did not complete: '+str(actual.get('diagnostics'))+' '+actual.get('stderr',''))
    expected=fingerprint(root)
    require(actual['versions']['packages']==expected['packages'] and actual['versions']['python'].startswith('3.12.'),'backend_incompatible','Observed backend versions differ from the exact lock.')
    observations={}
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='ontology-denial-') as temporary:
        sentinel=Path(temporary)/'sentinel.txt'; sentinel.write_text('unselected probe sentinel')
        listener=socket.socket(); listener.bind(('127.0.0.1',0)); listener.listen(); listener.settimeout(.01)
        port=listener.getsockname()[1]
        try:
            observations['file']=run_worker(python,'probe_file',{'path':str(sentinel)},bound)
            observations['network']=run_worker(python,'probe_network',{'port':port},bound)
            for name,url in (('parser_file',sentinel.as_uri()),('parser_network',f'http://127.0.0.1:{port}/context')):
                observations[name]=run_worker(python,'probe_parser',{'format':'json-ld','data':json.dumps({'@context':url,'@id':'urn:example:thing'})},bound)
            try: connection,_=listener.accept(); connection.close(); network_observed=True
            except socket.timeout: network_observed=False
            require(sentinel.read_text()=='unselected probe sentinel','probe_failure','Protected sentinel was modified.')
        finally: listener.close()
    observations['memory']=run_worker(python,'probe_memory',{},limits(overrides={'query_seconds':5}))
    observations['timeout']=run_worker(python,'probe_timeout',{},limits(overrides={'query_seconds':1}))
    cancel=threading.Event(); timer=threading.Timer(.2,cancel.set); timer.start()
    observations['cancel']=run_worker(python,'probe_timeout',{},bound,cancel=cancel); timer.join()
    for key,operation in (('malformed','probe_malformed'),('failure','probe_crash'),('output','probe_output')):
        observations[key]=run_worker(python,operation,{},bound)
    checks={k+'_denied':observations[k].get('denied') is True for k in ('file','network','parser_file','parser_network')}
    checks['network_denied']=checks['network_denied'] and not network_observed
    checks.update(memory_terminated=observations['memory'].get('status')=='memory_limit',timeout_terminated=observations['timeout'].get('status')=='timeout',
        cancelled=observations['cancel'].get('status')=='cancelled',malformed_ipc=observations['malformed'].get('status')=='malformed_ipc',
        worker_failure=observations['failure'].get('status')=='worker_failure',output_bounded=observations['output'].get('status')=='output_limit')
    result={'schema_version':1,'status':'validated' if all(checks.values()) else 'incomplete','platform':platform.system(),
        'versions':actual['versions'],'fingerprint':expected,'checks':checks,'observations':observations,
        'scope':'Darwin local standards worker only; no cross-host claim.'}
    from ontology_core import atomic_write
    target = safe_path(root, CERT, must_exist=False)
    previous = read_bytes(target) if target.exists() else None
    updated = canonical_bytes(result)
    if previous is not None and previous != updated:
        historical = 'control_records/ontology/profile-setup/certifications/' + sha256(previous) + '.json'
        retained = safe_path(root, historical, must_exist=False)
        if retained.exists():
            require(read_bytes(retained) == previous, 'certification_conflict', 'Retained certificate differs from its historical identity.')
        else:
            atomic_write(root, historical, previous, None)
    atomic_write(root, CERT, updated, sha256(previous) if previous is not None else None)
    return result


def setup_profile(root,profile='standards',*,provision=False,certification=True):
    """Only explicit setup callers may provision; ordinary APIs never call this."""
    require(profile=='standards','unsupported_profile','This setup owns standards only; select semantic setup separately.')
    env=Path(root)/ENV
    require(not env.is_symlink(),'unsafe_symlink','Selected runtime cannot be a symlink.')
    if provision:
        commands=[]
        if not env.exists(): commands.append([sys.executable,'-m','venv',str(env)])
        commands.extend([[str(env/'bin/python'),'-m','pip','install','--only-binary=:all:','--require-hashes','-r',str(PACKAGE/'requirements-standards.txt')],
                         [str(env/'bin/python'),'-m','pip','check']])
        for command in commands:
            completed=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True)
            require(completed.returncode==0,'profile_setup_failure','Selected standards setup failed: '+(completed.stderr or completed.stdout)[-800:])
    result = certify(root) if certification else {'status':'installed','fingerprint':fingerprint(root),'enabled':False}
    from ontology_health import maintenance_status
    return {**result, 'current_readiness': maintenance_status(root),
            'scope': 'selected backend certification; project runtime success is assessed separately'}


def preview_profile(root,profile,enabled,expected_config_sha256):
    import copy
    from ontology_core import exact
    require(profile in {'standards','inference','semantic','workbench'},'unsupported_profile','Configure only a separately selected optional profile; guard changes use guarded setup.')
    require(type(enabled) is bool,'invalid_profile','Profile enabled must be Boolean.')
    path=safe_path(root,'ontology-advanced.yaml')
    require(sha256(path)==expected_config_sha256,'config_changed','Advanced configuration changed after exact selection.')
    cfg=load_advanced(root,required=True); updated=copy.deepcopy(cfg)
    selected=updated['profiles'].setdefault(profile,{'enabled':False}); selected['enabled']=enabled
    content=canonical_bytes(updated)
    load_advanced(root,required=True,_overrides={'ontology-advanced.yaml':content})
    change={'path':'ontology-advanced.yaml','expected_sha256':expected_config_sha256,'content':content.decode(),'sha256':sha256(content)}
    return {'schema_version':1,'operation':'configure-profile','profile':profile,'enabled':enabled,'change':change,
            'guard_repair_required':False,
            'semantic_guard_required':cfg['profiles'].get('guards',{}).get('enabled',False)}


def configure_profile(root,profile,enabled,expected_config_sha256,authority):
    """Explicit local configuration under current Director authority, without setup."""
    from ontology_core import exact,load_project,operation_lock,atomic_write
    from ontology_authority import validate_native_observation,validate_director_binding,active_managers,within
    import re
    exact(authority,('schema_version','operation_id','operation','project_id','profile','enabled','expected_config_sha256',
          'actor_id','actor_kind','native_receipt','observed_at','expires_at'))
    require(authority['schema_version']==1 and authority['operation']=='configure-profile' and
            authority['profile']==profile and authority['enabled'] is enabled and
            authority['expected_config_sha256']==expected_config_sha256,'grant_scope','Setup authority must select these exact profile/configuration bytes.')
    require(isinstance(authority['operation_id'],str) and re.fullmatch(r'ONTPROFILE-[A-Za-z0-9-]{4,100}',authority['operation_id']),'invalid_operation','Use a unique ONTPROFILE operation identity.')
    intent_path='control_records/ontology/profile-setup/'+authority['operation_id']+'-intent.json'
    receipt_path='control_records/ontology/profile-setup/'+authority['operation_id']+'.json'
    intent_file=safe_path(root,intent_path,must_exist=False)
    if intent_file.exists():
        saved=decode_json(read_bytes(intent_file)); preview=saved['preview']
        before=saved.get('before_content','').encode()
        require(sha256(before)==expected_config_sha256,'intent_changed','Profile setup intent lost its exact accepted original configuration.')
        original=decode_json(before)
        original['profiles'].setdefault(profile,{'enabled':False})['enabled']=enabled
        require(canonical_bytes(original).decode()==preview['change']['content'] and sha256(canonical_bytes(original))==preview['change']['sha256'],'intent_changed','Profile intent includes changes beyond the selected enablement.')
        require(preview['profile']==profile and preview['enabled'] is enabled and preview['change']['expected_sha256']==expected_config_sha256,'operation_exists','Profile operation belongs to different reviewed bytes.')
        require(sha256(safe_path(root,'ontology-advanced.yaml')) in {expected_config_sha256,preview['change']['sha256']},'config_changed','Profile setup recovery does not match the accepted pre/post snapshots.')
    else: preview=preview_profile(root,profile,enabled,expected_config_sha256)
    guards_enabled = load_advanced(root,required=True)['profiles'].get('guards',{}).get('enabled',False)
    require(not (guards_enabled and profile == 'standards' and enabled is False),
            'guard_dependency','Enabled guards require the standards validation profile; keep it enabled while configuring other profiles.')
    from ontology_guards import begin_action,require_adapter,GuardError
    try:
        decision = begin_action(root,'setup','configure_profile',
            {'profile':profile,'enabled':enabled,'expected_config_sha256':expected_config_sha256,
             'authority':authority,'preview':preview},['ontology-advanced.yaml'])
        require_adapter(decision,__file__)
    except GuardError as exc:
        raise OntologyError(exc.code,str(exc)) from exc
    def recheck():
        try:
            decision.recheck()
            decision.lock_checked = True
        except GuardError as exc:
            raise OntologyError(exc.code,str(exc)) from exc
    def authorize():
        project=load_project(root,validate=False)
        require(authority['project_id']==project.project_id and authority['actor_kind']=='director','director_required','Profile configuration requires its current destination-local Director.')
        validate_native_observation(authority); validate_director_binding(project,authority['actor_id'])
        for _,_,assignment in active_managers(Path(root).absolute()):
            require(not any(within('ontology-advanced.yaml',scope) or within(scope,'ontology-advanced.yaml') for scope in assignment.get('fit',{}).get('writes',[])),'manager_owns_scope','An unreconciled manager owns the selected configuration.')
    authorize()
    with operation_lock(root,'control_records/ontology/publication.lock'):
        recheck()
        authorize()
        change=preview['change']
        current_sha=sha256(safe_path(root,change['path']))
        require(current_sha in {expected_config_sha256,change['sha256']},'config_changed','Profile changed at the mutation boundary.')
        receipt_file=safe_path(root,receipt_path,must_exist=False)
        if receipt_file.exists():
            existing=decode_json(read_bytes(receipt_file))
            require(current_sha==change['sha256'] and existing.get('change')=={k:change[k] for k in ('path','expected_sha256','sha256')},'config_changed','Completed profile receipt no longer matches the target.')
            from ontology_health import maintenance_status
            return decision.finish({**existing,'receipt_path':receipt_path,'receipt_sha256':sha256(receipt_file),'replayed':True,
                                    'current_readiness':maintenance_status(root)})
        if not intent_file.exists():
            require(preview_profile(root,profile,enabled,expected_config_sha256)==preview,'config_changed','Profile preview changed before setup intent.')
            atomic_write(root,intent_path,canonical_bytes({'schema_version':1,'preview':preview,'authority':authority,'before_content':read_bytes(safe_path(root,'ontology-advanced.yaml')).decode()}),None)
        recheck()
        if current_sha!=change['sha256']: atomic_write(root,change['path'],change['content'].encode(),expected_config_sha256)
        receipt={'schema_version':1,'status':'configured','profile':profile,'enabled':enabled,'provisioned':False,
            'change':{k:change[k] for k in ('path','expected_sha256','sha256')},'authority':authority}
        atomic_write(root,receipt_path,canonical_bytes(receipt),None)
    from ontology_health import maintenance_status
    return decision.finish({**receipt,'receipt_path':receipt_path,'receipt_sha256':sha256(safe_path(root,receipt_path)),
                            'current_readiness':maintenance_status(root)})

"""Project-scoped loopback workbench with trusted in-memory sessions and no browser grants."""
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from http.cookies import SimpleCookie
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
import copy
import json
import secrets
import threading
import time
import uuid
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

from ontology_core import (OntologyError, CORE, canonical_bytes, sha256, safe_path, read_bytes,
                           read_json, load_project, require, exact, source_status, decode_json)
from ontology_publication import _root
from ontology_proposals import save, list_proposals, open_proposal, decide

ASSETS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "workbench"
CSP = "default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'"


def assess_service(root, origin, *, timeout=2):
    """Probe one explicit loopback origin without redirects, cookies or startup."""
    from http.client import HTTPConnection, HTTPException
    import socket
    from ontology_advanced import load_advanced
    try:
        selected = urlsplit(origin)
        port = selected.port
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise OntologyError("invalid_service", "Select an explicit loopback port.") from exc
    require(selected.scheme == "http" and selected.hostname == "127.0.0.1" and port and
            selected.path in {"", "/"} and not any((selected.username, selected.password, selected.query, selected.fragment)),
            "invalid_service", "Select only http://127.0.0.1:PORT without credentials, query or fragment.")
    require(type(timeout) in (int, float) and 0 < timeout <= 5, "invalid_service", "Service timeout must be at most five seconds.")
    root = Path(root).absolute()
    project = load_project(root)
    config = load_advanced(root)
    enabled = bool(config and config["profiles"].get("workbench", {}).get("enabled"))
    result = {"enabled": enabled, "mode": "on_demand", "origin": f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}",
              "running": False, "service_state": "unreachable", "status": "unavailable", "mutated": False}
    connection = HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", port, timeout=timeout)
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
    timer = None
    expired = threading.Event()
    try:
        connection.connect()
        selected_socket = connection.sock
        def expire():
            expired.set()
            try:
                selected_socket.shutdown(socket.SHUT_RDWR)
            except OSError:
                pass  # The successful reader may already have closed its socket.
        remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
        if remaining <= 0:
            raise TimeoutError("Service connection exhausted its total budget.")
        timer = threading.Timer(remaining, expire)
        timer.daemon = True
        timer.start()
        connection.request("GET", "/health")
        response = connection.getresponse()
        raw = response.read(16385)
        require(response.status == 200 and len(raw) <= 16384, "invalid_service_response", "Selected service did not return a bounded health response.")
        observed = decode_json(raw)
        require(isinstance(observed, dict) and observed.get("service") == "sys4ai-ontology-workbench" and
                observed.get("schema_version") == 1, "invalid_service_response", "Selected endpoint is not a supported workbench.")
        matched = observed.get("project_id") == project.project_id and observed.get("root_sha256") == sha256(str(root).encode())
        current = (matched and observed.get("snapshot_sha256") == project.context()["snapshot_sha256"]
                   and observed.get("service_helper_sha256") == sha256(Path(__file__))
                   and observed.get("startup_helpers_sha256") == sha256(canonical_bytes(project.context()["helpers"]))
                   and observed.get("startup_config_sha256") == sha256(safe_path(root, "ontology-advanced.yaml")))
        result.update(service_state="running" if current else "stale_service" if matched else "wrong_project",
                      running=current, status="ready" if current and enabled else "unavailable",
                      observed_operation="loopback_identity_and_current_inputs", observed=observed)
    except (OSError, HTTPException) as exc:
        result.update(service_state="stopped" if isinstance(exc, ConnectionRefusedError) else "unreachable",
                      diagnostics=[{"code": "service_unreachable", "message": type(exc).__name__}])
    except OntologyError as exc:
        result.update(service_state="invalid_response", diagnostics=[exc.as_dict()])
    finally:
        connection.close()
        if timer is not None:
            timer.cancel()
            timer.join()
        if expired.is_set() or time.monotonic() >= deadline:
            result.update(service_state="timeout", running=False, status="unavailable",
                          diagnostics=[{"code": "service_timeout", "message": "Selected service exceeded its total network deadline."}])
    return result


@dataclass
class TrustedAuthority:
    """Created/refreshed only by a trusted local CLI or agent, outside HTTP input."""
    actor_id: str
    actor_kind: str
    native_receipt: dict
    observed_at: str
    expires_at: str
    scope: tuple
    task: dict | None = None

    def validate(self, root):
        from ontology_authority import validate_native_observation, validate_director_binding, validate_manager_binding, active_managers, within
        validate_native_observation(vars(self))
        project = load_project(root)
        require(project.config["publication"]["enabled"], "publication_disabled", "Current ontology publication is disabled.")
        configured = set(project.config["project_files"] + project.config["binding_files"] + project.config.get("competency_files", []))
        core_selected = set(configured)
        from ontology_advanced import load_advanced
        advanced = load_advanced(root)
        if advanced and advanced.get("publication", {}).get("enabled"):
            configured.add("ontology-advanced.yaml")
            for ref in advanced["extensions"]:
                configured.add(ref["path"])
                configured.update(item["path"] for item in read_json(safe_path(root, ref["path"])).get("shapes", []))
        require(self.scope and set(self.scope) <= configured, "session_scope", "Session authoring scope must name selected canonical project files.")
        if self.actor_kind == "director":
            binding = validate_director_binding(project, self.actor_id)
            require(self.task is None and all(any(within(path, prefix) for prefix in binding["scope"]) for path in self.scope if path in core_selected),
                    "session_scope", "Session exceeds the current Director's bound canonical scope.")
            if set(self.scope) - core_selected:
                advanced_binding = advanced["publication"]["binding"]
                require(advanced_binding["actor_id"] == self.actor_id and all(any(within(path, prefix) for prefix in advanced_binding["scope"]) for path in self.scope if path not in core_selected),
                        "session_scope", "Advanced session scope exceeds its separate current publication binding.")
                for ref in advanced_binding["authority"]:
                    require(sha256(safe_path(root, ref["path"])) == ref["sha256"], "authority_changed", "Advanced session governing authority changed.")
            for _, _, assignment in active_managers(project.root):
                require(not any(within(path, prefix) or within(prefix, path) for path in self.scope for prefix in assignment.get("fit", {}).get("writes", [])),
                        "manager_owns_scope", "An unreconciled active manager owns overlapping session targets.")
        else:
            require(isinstance(self.task, dict) and isinstance(self.task.get("path"), str), "manager_unconfirmed", "A manager session needs its exact confirmed Task.")
            validate_manager_binding(project, self.actor_id, self.task, self.scope)
        return project

    def grant(self, root, current):
        self.validate(root)
        from ontology_authority import review_binding
        proposal = current["revision"]["candidate"]
        require(set(c["path"] for c in proposal["changes"]) <= set(self.scope), "session_scope", "Candidate publication exceeds trusted session scope.")
        config = safe_path(root, "ontology-advanced.yaml", must_exist=False)
        return {"schema_version": 2, "grant_id": "ONTGRANT-workbench-" + uuid.uuid4().hex,
                "project_id": current["revision"]["project_id"], "actor_id": self.actor_id,
                "actor_kind": self.actor_kind, "operation": "publish",
                "payload_sha256": sha256(canonical_bytes(proposal)),
                "preview_sha256": current["validation"]["preview"]["preview_sha256"],
                "config_sha256": sha256(safe_path(root, "ontology.yaml")),
                "advanced_config_sha256": current["validation"]["target_snapshot"].get("advanced_inputs", {}).get("ontology-advanced.yaml", sha256(config) if config.exists() else None),
                "proposal_review": review_binding(current), "scope": [c["path"] for c in proposal["changes"]],
                "native_receipt": copy.deepcopy(self.native_receipt), "observed_at": self.observed_at,
                "expires_at": self.expires_at, "task": copy.deepcopy(self.task),
                "reviewed_records": [{k:c[k] for k in ("path", "sha256", "expected_sha256")} for c in proposal["changes"]]}


def trusted_authority(root, *, actor_id, actor_kind, native_receipt, observed_at, scope, task=None):
    observed = datetime.fromisoformat(observed_at.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    value = TrustedAuthority(actor_id, actor_kind, copy.deepcopy(native_receipt), observed_at,
                             (observed + timedelta(minutes=5)).isoformat(), tuple(scope), copy.deepcopy(task))
    value.validate(_root(root))
    return value


def _source(project, reference):
    exact(reference, ("path", "locator"), ("sha256",))
    permitted = set(project.config["source_allowlist"])
    for module in project.modules:
        permitted.update(module["path"] + "/" + name for name in module["files"])
    require(reference["path"] in permitted, "source_unselected", "Only a selected ontology source can be opened.")
    path = safe_path(project.root, reference["path"])
    raw = read_bytes(path, max_bytes=250000)
    ref = {"path": reference["path"], "sha256": reference.get("sha256", sha256(raw)), "locator": reference["locator"]}
    require(source_status(project, ref)["status"] == "current", "source_not_current", "Source evidence changed; choose its current version.")
    return ref


def draft_form(root, form, *, expected_target_sha256, proposal_id=None, expected_revision=None, scope):
    """The form edits supported fields; it has no actor, file, grant or executable input."""
    root = _root(root)
    project = load_project(root)
    exact(form, ("id", "kind", "label", "definition", "types", "aliases", "sources", "reason"),
          ("scope_note", "lifecycle", "replacement", "deprecation_reason", "domain", "range", "acyclic", "cardinality",
           "qualifier_schema", "qualifiers", "subject", "predicate", "object", "entity", "binding_type"))
    kind = form["kind"]
    require(kind in {"concept", "instance", "predicate", "relation", "binding"}, "unsupported_kind", "Choose a supported ontology record kind.")
    rid = form["id"]
    require(isinstance(rid, str) and rid.startswith(project.namespace), "core_redefinition", "Imported identities are protected. Use a distinct project identity.")
    canonical = project.by_id.get(rid)
    selected_path = project.locations[rid].split("#")[0] if canonical else project.config["binding_files" if kind == "binding" else "project_files"][0]
    require(selected_path in scope, "session_scope", "This record is outside the trusted authoring scope.")
    actual = sha256(safe_path(root, selected_path))
    require(actual == expected_target_sha256, "target_conflict", "Canonical content changed. Your entered draft is preserved; reopen its current target before saving.")
    candidate = None
    if proposal_id:
        existing = open_proposal(root, proposal_id)
        require(existing["head"]["revision"] == expected_revision, "draft_conflict", "A newer saved draft exists. Your form input is preserved.")
        candidate = copy.deepcopy(existing["revision"]["candidate"])
        require(all(c["path"] in scope for c in candidate["changes"]), "session_scope", "Saved candidate exceeds trusted authoring scope.")
    if candidate is None:
        candidate = {"schema_version": 1, "operation_id": "ONTOP-" + uuid.uuid4().hex,
                     "operation": "publish", "reason": form["reason"], "changes": []}
    # Every revision is a new unaccepted operation; only recovery reuses an accepted operation ID.
    candidate["operation_id"] = "ONTOP-" + uuid.uuid4().hex
    candidate["reason"] = form["reason"]
    change = next((c for c in candidate["changes"] if c["path"] == selected_path), None)
    document = decode_json(change["content"].encode()) if change else read_json(safe_path(root, selected_path))
    previous = next((r for r in document["@graph"] if r["@id"] == rid), None)
    record = copy.deepcopy(previous or {})
    record.update({"@id": rid, "@type": form["types"], "kind": kind, "label": form["label"],
                   "definition": form["definition"], "aliases": form["aliases"], "module": "project",
                   "fact_kind": "asserted", "lifecycle": form.get("lifecycle", "approved"),
                   "sources": [_source(project, source) for source in form["sources"]]})
    allowed = {"scope_note"}
    if kind == "predicate":
        allowed.update(("domain", "range", "acyclic", "cardinality"))
        record["qualifiers"] = form.get("qualifier_schema", {})
    elif kind == "relation":
        allowed.update(("subject", "predicate", "object", "qualifiers"))
    elif kind == "binding":
        allowed.update(("entity", "binding_type"))
    for key in allowed:
        if key in form and form[key] not in (None, ""):
            record[key] = form[key]
    # No ID recycling or silent destruction.  History always links the previous canonical meaning.
    if canonical:
        require(canonical["kind"] == kind and canonical["@type"] == record["@type"], "identity_recycled", "Existing identity kind and types are protected; create a distinct identity.")
        require(canonical.get("lifecycle") != "deprecated" or record["definition"] == canonical["definition"] and record["lifecycle"] == "deprecated",
                "retired_identity", "Deprecated identities retain their historical meaning.")
        if record != canonical:
            from ontology_lifecycle import transition
            history = transition(canonical, record["lifecycle"], reason=form["reason"], replacement=form.get("replacement"))
            record["history"] = history["history"]
    if record["lifecycle"] == "deprecated":
        record["deprecation_reason"] = form.get("deprecation_reason") or form["reason"]
        if form.get("replacement"):
            record["replacement"] = form["replacement"]
    else:
        record.pop("deprecation_reason", None)
        record.pop("replacement", None)
    document["@graph"] = [record if r["@id"] == rid else r for r in document["@graph"]]
    if previous is None:
        document["@graph"].append(record)
    raw = canonical_bytes(document)
    from ontology_core import parse_document
    parse_document(raw, project.config["context"]["path"], selected_path)
    new_change = {"path": selected_path, "expected_sha256": actual, "content": raw.decode(), "sha256": sha256(raw)}
    candidate["changes"] = [new_change if c["path"] == selected_path else c for c in candidate["changes"]]
    if change is None:
        candidate["changes"].append(new_change)
    return save(root, candidate, proposal_id=proposal_id, expected_revision=expected_revision,
                rationale=form["reason"], evidence=record["sources"], uncertainty=[],
                generator={"kind": "human_form", "runtime_invoked": False})


class Workbench:
    def __init__(self, root, authority=None, *, host="127.0.0.1", port=None):
        self.root = _root(root)
        require(host == "127.0.0.1", "workbench_host", "Workbench supports loopback only; remote deployment is a separate operation.")
        self.project = load_project(self.root)
        self.startup_helpers_sha256 = sha256(canonical_bytes(self.project.context()["helpers"]))
        self.helper_sha256 = sha256(Path(__file__))
        self.startup_config_sha256 = sha256(safe_path(self.root, "ontology-advanced.yaml"))
        from ontology_advanced import load_advanced
        cfg = load_advanced(self.root)
        profile = cfg["profiles"].get("workbench", {"enabled": False}) if cfg else {"enabled": False}
        require(profile.get("enabled"), "workbench_disabled", "Enable the selected local workbench profile before starting its service.")
        self.session_seconds = profile.get("session_seconds", 900)
        self.max_request_bytes = profile.get("max_request_bytes", 1000000)
        self.authority = authority
        if authority:
            authority.validate(self.root)
        self.scope = tuple(authority.scope) if authority else ()
        self.sessions, self.bootstrap = {}, {}
        self.mutex = threading.RLock()
        service = self

        class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
            server_version = "Sys4AIWorkbench"
            sys_version = ""

            def log_message(self, format, *args):
                pass  # Session bootstrap and source data never enter an access log.

            def _headers(self, code, content_type, length, cookie=None):
                self.send_response(code)
                self.send_header("Content-Type", content_type)
                self.send_header("Content-Length", str(length))
                self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
                self.send_header("Content-Security-Policy", CSP)
                self.send_header("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
                self.send_header("Referrer-Policy", "no-referrer")
                self.send_header("Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy", "same-origin")
                if cookie:
                    self.send_header("Set-Cookie", cookie)
                self.end_headers()

            def _json(self, code, data, cookie=None):
                raw = canonical_bytes(data)
                self._headers(code, "application/json; charset=utf-8", len(raw), cookie)
                self.wfile.write(raw)

            def _origin(self, *, mutation=False):
                require(self.headers.get("Host") == service.host_header, "host_forbidden", "This request does not name the selected local service.")
                origin = self.headers.get("Origin")
                require((not mutation and origin is None) or origin == service.origin, "origin_forbidden", "Only this workbench's local origin may call its endpoints.")
                require(self.headers.get("Sec-Fetch-Site") not in {"cross-site"}, "origin_forbidden", "Cross-site requests are forbidden.")

            def do_GET(self):
                try:
                    self._origin()
                    selected = urlsplit(self.path)
                    if selected.path == "/health" and not selected.query:
                        project = load_project(service.root)
                        self._json(200, {"schema_version": 1, "service": "sys4ai-ontology-workbench",
                                         "project_id": project.project_id,
                                         "root_sha256": sha256(str(service.root).encode()),
                                         "service_helper_sha256": service.helper_sha256,
                                         "startup_helpers_sha256": service.startup_helpers_sha256,
                                         "startup_config_sha256": service.startup_config_sha256,
                                         "snapshot_sha256": project.context()["snapshot_sha256"]})
                        return
                    require(not selected.query and selected.path in {"/", "/index.html", "/app.js", "/editor.js", "/review.js", "/advanced.js", "/styles.css"}, "resource_forbidden", "Select an available local workbench resource.")
                    name = "index.html" if selected.path == "/" else selected.path[1:]
                    path = ASSETS / name
                    require(path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink(), "resource_forbidden", "Workbench asset unavailable.")
                    raw = read_bytes(path)
                    mime = "text/html" if name.endswith(".html") else "text/css" if name.endswith(".css") else "text/javascript"
                    self._headers(200, mime + "; charset=utf-8", len(raw))
                    self.wfile.write(raw)
                except OntologyError as exc:
                    self._json(403, {"status": "rejected", "error": exc.as_dict()})

            def do_POST(self):
                try:
                    self._origin(mutation=True)
                    require(self.headers.get("Content-Type", "").split(";")[0] == "application/json", "content_type", "Workbench endpoints require JSON data.")
                    length = self.headers.get("Content-Length", "")
                    require(length.isdigit() and 0 < int(length) <= service.max_request_bytes, "request_size", "Request body is missing or exceeds the selected budget.")
                    body = decode_json(self.rfile.read(int(length)))
                    require(isinstance(body, dict), "invalid_request", "Expected an endpoint request object.")
                    require(not any(k in body for k in ("actor", "actor_id", "actor_kind", "grant", "native_receipt", "project_root", "scope")),
                            "browser_authority", "Browser requests cannot supply actor authority, grants or project scope.")
                    if self.path == "/api/session":
                        exact(body, ("bootstrap",))
                        with service.mutex:
                            token = body["bootstrap"]
                            require(isinstance(token, str) and token in service.bootstrap and service.bootstrap[token] >= time.monotonic(), "session_expired", "Open a current trusted bootstrap link.")
                            del service.bootstrap[token]
                            existing = SimpleCookie()
                            existing.load(self.headers.get("Cookie", ""))
                            current = existing.get(service.cookie_name)
                            sid = current.value if current else None
                            session = service.sessions.get(sid)
                            if not session or session["expires"] < time.monotonic():
                                sid = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
                                session = {"csrf": secrets.token_urlsafe(32), "expires": time.monotonic() + service.session_seconds}
                                service.sessions[sid] = session
                            csrf = session["csrf"]
                        self._json(200, {"status": "connected", "csrf": csrf}, service.cookie_name + "=" + sid + "; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/")
                        return
                    cookie = SimpleCookie()
                    cookie.load(self.headers.get("Cookie", ""))
                    sid = cookie.get(service.cookie_name)
                    session = service.sessions.get(sid.value if sid else "")
                    require(session and session["expires"] >= time.monotonic(), "session_expired", "Session expired. Saved proposals remain available after trusted reconnect.")
                    csrf = self.headers.get("X-Ontology-CSRF", "")
                    require(isinstance(csrf, str) and secrets.compare_digest(csrf, session["csrf"]), "csrf_forbidden", "A current same-session request token is required.")
                    result = service.dispatch(self.path, body)
                    self._json(200, result)
                except OntologyError as exc:
                    code = 409 if exc.code in {"draft_conflict", "target_conflict", "stale_review", "expected_changed", "write_conflict", "operation_locked"} else 403 if exc.code in {"host_forbidden", "origin_forbidden", "csrf_forbidden", "session_expired", "browser_authority", "session_scope", "publication_unavailable", "grant_expired"} else 422
                    self._json(code, {"status": "conflict" if code == 409 else "unavailable" if code == 403 else "invalid", "error": exc.as_dict(), "draft_preserved": True})
                except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError) as exc:
                    self._json(422, {"status": "invalid", "error": {"code": "request_failed", "message": str(exc)[:500]}, "draft_preserved": True})

            def do_OPTIONS(self):
                self._json(403, {"status": "rejected", "error": {"code": "origin_forbidden", "message": "Cross-origin access is unsupported."}})

        self.server = ThreadingHTTPServer((host, profile.get("port", 0) if port is None else port), Handler)
        self.server.daemon_threads = True
        self.server.timeout = 1
        # Browser cookies are host-scoped, not port-scoped. Concurrent local
        # services must not overwrite each other's session identifiers.
        self.cookie_name = "sys4ai_ontology_session_" + str(self.server.server_port)
        self.origin = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.server.server_port}"
        self.host_header = f"127.0.0.1:{self.server.server_port}"
        self.thread = None

    def bootstrap_url(self):
        token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
        with self.mutex:
            self.bootstrap[token] = time.monotonic() + 60
        return self.origin + "/#bootstrap=" + token

    def start(self):
        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        self.thread.start()
        from ontology_health import maintenance_status
        self.startup_readiness = {"service": assess_service(self.root, self.origin),
                                  "dependencies": maintenance_status(self.root),
                                  "operational_readiness": "service observed; other runtime operations not exercised"}
        return self

    def close(self):
        if self.thread:
            self.server.shutdown()
            self.thread.join(timeout=5)
        self.server.server_close()
        self.sessions.clear()
        self.bootstrap.clear()

    def _authoring(self):
        require(self.authority is not None, "publication_unavailable", "This is a browsing session. Trusted local authority is required for authoring.")
        self.authority.validate(self.root)

    def dispatch(self, endpoint, body):
        project = load_project(self.root)
        if endpoint == "/api/state":
            exact(body, ())
            from ontology_standards import health
            from ontology_proposals import list_rdf_imports
            return {"status": "ready", "project": project.config["project"], "context": project.context(),
                    "readiness": health(self.root), "authoring": bool(self.authority),
                    "scope": list(self.scope), "targets": [{"path": p, "sha256": sha256(safe_path(self.root, p))} for p in self.scope],
                    "source_choices": project.config["source_allowlist"], "proposals": list_proposals(self.root),
                    "rdf_imports": [{k:item[k] for k in ("import_id", "disposition", "diagnostics", "proposal_id")} for item in list_rdf_imports(self.root)],
                    "authority_boundary": "Trusted local session; current native authority and exact review are rechecked at publication."}
        if endpoint == "/api/records":
            exact(body, (), ("query", "module", "kind", "type", "lifecycle", "fact_kind", "limit"))
            limit = body.get("limit", 100)
            require(type(limit) is int and 1 <= limit <= 100, "invalid_limit", "Choose one to one hundred records.")
            query = body.get("query", "").casefold().strip()
            rows = []
            for record in project.records:
                terms = [record["@id"], record.get("label", ""), *record.get("aliases", [])]
                if query and not any(query in term.casefold() for term in terms):
                    continue
                if any(body.get(key) and record.get(key) != body[key] for key in ("module", "kind", "lifecycle", "fact_kind")):
                    continue
                if body.get("type") and body["type"] not in record["@type"]:
                    continue
                location = project.locations[record["@id"]].split("#")[0]
                rows.append({**record, "location": location, "editable": location in self.scope,
                             "classification": "imported assertion" if record["@id"].startswith(CORE) else record["fact_kind"],
                             "target_sha256": sha256(safe_path(self.root, location))})
            return {"status": "complete", "records": rows[:limit], "truncated": len(rows) > limit,
                    "filters": {"modules": sorted({r["module"] for r in project.records}), "types": sorted({t for r in project.records for t in r["@type"]})}}
        if endpoint == "/api/inspect":
            exact(body, ("id",))
            require(body["id"] in project.by_id, "unknown_identity", "Selected identity is unavailable.")
            from ontology_graph import neighbors
            from ontology_retrieval import explain
            record = project.by_id[body["id"]]
            related = [r for r in project.relations if record["@id"] in (r["subject"], r["object"])]
            row = explain(project, record)
            location = project.locations[record["@id"]].split("#")[0]
            row.update(location=location, editable=location in self.scope, target_sha256=sha256(safe_path(self.root, location)))
            return {"status": "complete", "record": row, "graph": neighbors(project, record["@id"], hops=1, limit=50),
                    "relations": related[:50], "truncated": len(related) > 50}
        if endpoint == "/api/source":
            exact(body, ("reference",))
            ref = _source(project, body["reference"])
            return {"status": "current", "reference": ref, "text": read_bytes(safe_path(self.root, ref["path"]), max_bytes=250000).decode("utf-8")}
        if endpoint == "/api/proposal":
            exact(body, ("id",), ("revision",))
            return open_proposal(self.root, body["id"], revision=body.get("revision"))
        if endpoint == "/api/draft":
            exact(body, ("form", "expected_target_sha256"), ("proposal_id", "expected_revision"))
            self._authoring()
            return draft_form(self.root, body["form"], expected_target_sha256=body["expected_target_sha256"],
                              proposal_id=body.get("proposal_id"), expected_revision=body.get("expected_revision"), scope=self.scope)
        if endpoint == "/api/validate":
            exact(body, ("id", "revision"))
            self._authoring()
            from ontology_proposal_validation import validate_candidate
            return validate_candidate(self.root, body["id"], expected_revision=body["revision"])
        if endpoint == "/api/decide":
            exact(body, ("id", "revision", "decision", "reason"), ("validation_sha256", "superseded_by"))
            self._authoring()
            return decide(self.root, body["id"], expected_revision=body["revision"], decision=body["decision"], reason=body["reason"],
                          validation_sha256=body.get("validation_sha256"), superseded_by=body.get("superseded_by"))
        if endpoint == "/api/publish":
            exact(body, ("id", "revision", "review_sha256"))
            self._authoring()
            current = open_proposal(self.root, body["id"])
            from ontology_proposal_validation import publish_revision
            return publish_revision(self.root, body["id"], self.authority.grant(self.root, current), expected_revision=body["revision"], expected_review_sha256=body["review_sha256"])
        if endpoint == "/api/recover":
            exact(body, ("id", "revision"))
            self._authoring()
            current = open_proposal(self.root, body["id"])
            require(current["head"]["revision"] == body["revision"] and current["head"]["state"] == "partial", "stale_review", "Select the current partially committed operation.")
            from ontology_publication import recover
            from ontology_proposals import _event
            receipt = recover(self.root, current["revision"]["candidate"]["operation_id"], self.authority.grant(self.root, current))
            reopened = [{"path": c["path"], "actual_sha256": sha256(safe_path(self.root, c["path"])),
                         "matches_candidate": sha256(safe_path(self.root, c["path"])) == c["sha256"]} for c in current["revision"]["candidate"]["changes"]]
            complete = receipt.get("status") == "complete" and all(item["matches_candidate"] for item in reopened)
            result = _event(self.root, body["id"], body["revision"], "published" if complete else "partial", {"receipt": receipt, "reopened": reopened})
            return {"status": "published" if complete else "partial", "receipt": receipt, "reopened": reopened, "proposal": result}
        if endpoint == "/api/advanced":
            exact(body, ("operation",), ("query", "graphs", "goals"))
            import ontology_standards as standards
            require(body["operation"] in {"query", "infer", "validate", "health"}, "unsupported_operation", "Select a supported read-only advanced operation.")
            if body["operation"] == "query":
                return standards.query(self.root, body.get("query", ""), graphs=body.get("graphs"))
            if body["operation"] == "infer":
                return standards.infer(self.root, goals=body.get("goals"))
            if body["operation"] == "validate":
                return standards.validate(self.root, graphs=body.get("graphs"))
            return standards.health(self.root)
        if endpoint == "/api/generate":
            exact(body, ("sources", "context_ids", "instruction"), ("previous_request", "findings", "proposal_id"))
            self._authoring()
            from ontology_generation import prepare
            # Browsers prepare requests; only a trusted current native invocation captures results.
            return prepare(self.root, sources=[_source(project, s) for s in body["sources"]],
                           context_ids=body["context_ids"], instruction=body["instruction"],
                           runtime={"kind": "native_agent", "tool": "native-current-agent",
                                    "settings": {"model": None, "reasoning_effort": None, "observed": False},
                                    "authorization": "Trusted local workbench request; current native agent must confirm permitted runtime before invocation."},
                           previous_request=body.get("previous_request"), findings=body.get("findings"), proposal_id=body.get("proposal_id"))
        if endpoint == "/api/import":
            exact(body, ("source", "format", "reason"), ("manifest", "target_extension"))
            self._authoring()
            reference = _source(project, body["source"])
            if body.get("target_extension"):
                # Browser session scopes contain core target files only; advanced imports remain staged.
                require(body["target_extension"] in self.scope, "session_scope", "Extension conversion requires separately scoped trusted authoring authority.")
            from ontology_standards import stage_import
            from ontology_proposals import stage_rdf_import
            staged = stage_import(self.root, read_bytes(safe_path(self.root, reference["path"])).decode("utf-8"), body["format"], manifest=body.get("manifest"))
            if not staged.get("complete"):
                return staged
            return stage_rdf_import(self.root, staged, reference, body["reason"], body.get("target_extension"))
        if endpoint == "/api/rdf-import":
            exact(body, ("id",))
            from ontology_proposals import read_rdf_import
            return read_rdf_import(self.root, body["id"])
        require(False, "resource_forbidden", "This workbench endpoint is unavailable.")

"""Fixed, local Basic Memory queries over a verified disposable projection.

No vendor CLI, MCP tool, server startup, project discovery, sync, or publication
is exposed. The SQLite and Python checks are application controls, not an OS
sandbox. Every public result is reconstructed from current canonical documents.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
import os
import stat
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, quote, unquote, urlsplit

from basic_memory_projection import canonical_json, digest, verify_projection
from memory_paths import MemoryError, project_root, require, safe_path, safe_read_bytes

PROFILE = "basic-memory-v0.23.0"
VERSION = "0.23.0"
OPERATIONS = ("search", "health")
MODES = ("text", "vector", "hybrid")


def _limitations(error):
    code = "backend_timeout" if isinstance(error, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) else getattr(error, "code", "backend_unavailable")
    if code == "file_absent":
        return [code, "A required backend profile, certificate, projection, or index file is absent; explicit setup or reindex is required."]
    if isinstance(error, FileNotFoundError):
        return ["backend_model_absent", "A pinned local model artifact is absent; reads do not download or repair it."]
    return [code]


def _config(root, supplied):
    from memory_core import load_config
    current = load_config(root)
    require(supplied is None or supplied == current, "backend_config_changed", "Use the current project configuration.")
    return current


def load_profile(root, config):
    raw = safe_read_bytes(root, config["contract_root"] + "/profiles/" + PROFILE + ".json")
    from memory_core import decode_json_yaml
    value = decode_json_yaml(raw)
    require(value.get("profile_id") == PROFILE and value.get("backend_version") == VERSION,
            "backend_profile", "Unsupported Basic Memory profile.")
    require(value.get("query_contract", {}).get("operations") == list(OPERATIONS),
            "backend_operations", "Backend writer operations are prohibited.")
    return value, digest(raw)


def _file_digest(path):
    value = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            value.update(block)
    return value.hexdigest()


def _model_directory(root, config, profile):
    model = profile["model"]
    rel = config["state"]["model_cache"] + "/" + model["revision"]
    directory = safe_path(root, rel, kind="dir")
    for artifact in model["files"]:
        # Tokenizer artifact names contain "tokens" but are immutable model data,
        # not candidate source/credential paths. Only the pinned direct children
        # of the already confined model directory enter this narrow exception.
        require(Path(artifact["path"]).name == artifact["path"], "backend_model_path", "Model artifact must be a direct child.")
        target = directory / artifact["path"]
        info = target.lstat()
        require(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_nlink == 1,
                "backend_model_path", "Model artifacts must be regular, unlinked files.")
        require(target.stat().st_size == artifact["bytes"] and _file_digest(target) == artifact["sha256"],
                "backend_model_changed", "Pinned local model artifact is missing or changed.")
    require({p.name for p in directory.iterdir()} == {a["path"] for a in model["files"]},
            "backend_model_changed", "Unclassified model files are present.")
    return directory


def verify_index(root, config):
    index = safe_path(root, config["state"]["index"], kind="dir")
    require({p.name for p in index.iterdir()} == {"basic-memory.db", "manifest.json"},
            "unclassified_index", "Unclassified or active database products prevent read-only queries.")
    manifest_path = config["state"]["index"] + "/manifest.json"
    from memory_core import decode_json_yaml
    manifest = decode_json_yaml(safe_read_bytes(root, manifest_path))
    database_path = config["state"]["index"] + "/basic-memory.db"
    actual = _file_digest(safe_path(root, database_path))
    require(manifest == {"classification": "rebuildable-index", "files": {"basic-memory.db": actual}},
            "backend_index_manifest", "Index bytes or ownership manifest changed.",
            {"path": database_path, "expected_sha256": manifest.get("files", {}).get("basic-memory.db") if isinstance(manifest.get("files"), dict) else None, "current_sha256": actual})
    certificate = decode_json_yaml(safe_read_bytes(root, config["state"]["backend_config"] + "/certification.json"))
    require(certificate.get("project_id") == config["project"]["id"] and certificate.get("project_root") == str(root),
            "backend_project", "Index certificate belongs to another project.")
    require(certificate.get("database_sha256") == actual, "backend_database_changed", "Index does not match its certification.",
            {"path": database_path, "expected_sha256": certificate.get("database_sha256"), "current_sha256": actual})
    projection = verify_projection(root, config)
    require(certificate.get("projection_sha256") == digest(safe_read_bytes(root, config["state"]["projection"] + "/manifest.json")),
            "backend_projection_changed", "Index was certified against another projection.")
    return {"database_sha256": actual, "projection_documents": len(projection["entries"])}


def _read_certificate(root, config, *, documents=None):
    from memory_maintenance import pending_reindexes
    require(not pending_reindexes(root, config), "maintenance_pending", "Backend rebuild recovery is pending.")
    profile, profile_sha = load_profile(root, config)
    rel = config["state"]["backend_config"] + "/certification.json"
    from memory_core import decode_json_yaml
    certificate = decode_json_yaml(safe_read_bytes(root, rel))
    require(certificate.get("schema_version") == 1 and certificate.get("project_id") == config["project"]["id"]
            and certificate.get("project_root") == str(root), "backend_project", "Backend certificate belongs to another project.")
    require(certificate.get("profile_sha256") == profile_sha, "backend_profile_changed", "Pinned backend profile changed.",
            {"path": config["contract_root"] + "/profiles/" + PROFILE + ".json", "expected_sha256": certificate.get("profile_sha256"), "current_sha256": profile_sha})
    require(certificate.get("adapter_sha256") == _file_digest(Path(__file__)),
            "backend_adapter_changed", "Query implementation changed after backend certification.",
            {"path": ".agents/skills/memory/scripts/basic_memory_adapter.py", "expected_sha256": certificate.get("adapter_sha256"), "current_sha256": _file_digest(Path(__file__))})
    require(certificate.get("config_sha256") == digest(safe_read_bytes(root, "memory.yaml")),
            "backend_config_changed", "Backend certificate configuration is stale.",
            {"path": "memory.yaml", "expected_sha256": certificate.get("config_sha256"), "current_sha256": digest(safe_read_bytes(root, "memory.yaml"))})
    require(certificate.get("backend_config_sha256") == digest(safe_read_bytes(root, config["state"]["backend_config"] + "/config.json")),
            "backend_config_changed", "Effective backend configuration changed.")
    projection = verify_projection(root, config, current_documents=documents)
    require(certificate.get("projection_sha256") == digest(safe_read_bytes(root, config["state"]["projection"] + "/manifest.json")),
            "backend_projection_changed", "Backend certificate projection changed.")
    db = safe_path(root, config["state"]["index"] + "/basic-memory.db")
    require(_file_digest(db) == certificate.get("database_sha256"), "backend_database_changed", "Backend database is stale or changed.",
            {"path": config["state"]["index"] + "/basic-memory.db", "expected_sha256": certificate.get("database_sha256"), "current_sha256": _file_digest(db)})
    index = safe_path(root, config["state"]["index"], kind="dir")
    require({p.name for p in index.iterdir()} == {"basic-memory.db", "manifest.json"},
            "unclassified_index", "Unclassified or active database products prevent read-only queries.")
    manifest = json.loads(safe_read_bytes(root, config["state"]["index"] + "/manifest.json"))
    require(manifest == {"classification": "rebuildable-index", "files": {"basic-memory.db": certificate["database_sha256"]}},
            "backend_index_manifest", "Index ownership manifest changed.")
    _model_directory(root, config, profile)
    return profile, certificate, projection


def health(root, config=None, *, level="static"):
    """Static reads launch nothing; operational selection probes the fixed worker."""
    root = project_root(root)
    try:
        require(level in {"static", "operational"}, "health_level", "Expected static or operational health.")
        config = _config(root, config)
        if not config["backend"]["enabled"] or not config["backend"]["semantic_enabled"]:
            return {"available": False, "mode": "lexical", "limitations": ["backend_disabled"], "runtime": {"status": "not_selected"}}
        profile, certificate, projection = _read_certificate(root, config)
        _runtime_python(root)
        runtime = {"status": "not_exercised"}
        if level == "operational":
            request = {"root": str(root), "operation": "health", "query": "memory health", "mode": "hybrid", "limit": 1,
                       "profile_sha256": certificate["profile_sha256"]}
            observed = run_worker(root, config, request, timeout_seconds=30)
            # Recheck final bytes after a successful representative semantic read.
            _read_certificate(root, config)
            runtime = {"status": "passed", "operation": "bounded_hybrid_read", "dispatch": "not_exercised",
                       "details": {k: v for k, v in observed.items() if k not in {"results", "ok"}}}
        return {"available": True, "mode": "prebuilt-profile", "profile": profile["profile_id"],
                "documents": len(projection["entries"]), "runtime": runtime,
                "inputs": certificate, "limitations": ["runtime_not_started_by_health"] if level == "static" else []}
    except (MemoryError, OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as exc:
        error = exc.as_dict() if isinstance(exc, MemoryError) else {"code": "backend_timeout" if isinstance(exc, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) else "backend_unavailable", "message": "Required backend assessment failed.", "details": {"exception": type(exc).__name__}}
        return {"available": False, "mode": "lexical", "limitations": _limitations(exc), "error": error,
                "diagnostics": [error], "runtime": {"status": "failed" if level == "operational" else "not_exercised"}}


def _runtime_python(root):
    try:
        if importlib.metadata.version("basic-memory") == VERSION:
            return sys.executable
    except importlib.metadata.PackageNotFoundError:
        pass
    executable = root / ".venv-memory-pilot/bin/python"
    require(executable.is_file(), "backend_runtime_absent", "Pinned local pilot runtime is not installed.")
