        diagnostics.append({"code": "claim_unsupported", "severity": "error", "message": "Accessible cited evidence does not support the stated claim level."})
    try:
        check_origin(root, meta["origin"])
    except MemoryError as exc:
        diagnostics.append({"code": exc.code, "severity": "warning", "details": exc.details,
                            "message": "Origin is absent, changed, or ineligible; current Task and role sources retain authority."})
    applicability = ("not_claimed" if level == "historical_context" else
                     "changed" if any(v["current_applicability"] == "changed" for v in verifications) else
                     "unverified" if diagnostics or any(v["applicability"] == "historical" for v in verifications) else "current")
    return {"historical_support": ("context_only" if level == "historical_context" and not diagnostics else
                                   "supported" if supported and source_integrity and not any(v["historical_support"] == "unsupported" for v in verifications) else "unsupported"),
            "current_applicability": applicability, "durable": bool(verifications) and all(v["durable"] for v in verifications),
            "verified_current": level == "verified_outcome" and applicability == "current" and not diagnostics and meta["state"] == "active",
            "verifications": verifications, "diagnostics": diagnostics}


def inspect_evidence(root, record, config=None):
    """Legacy list interface; richer support/applicability is available separately."""
    return assess_evidence(root, record, config)["diagnostics"]


def validate_publication_evidence(root, record, config=None):
    evidence = assess_evidence(root, record, config)
    require(not evidence["diagnostics"], "evidence_unqualified", "Publication requires supported evidence and real origin references.", {"diagnostics": evidence["diagnostics"]})
    if record["metadata"]["claim"]["level"] == "verified_outcome":
        require(evidence["durable"] and evidence["current_applicability"] == "current"
                and all(v["applicability"] == "current" for v in evidence["verifications"]),
                "durable_evidence_required", "New verified claims require retained observed bytes and explicit current applicability; legacy records remain readable.")
    return evidence["diagnostics"]

"""Explicit, authorized rebuilding of classified memory retrieval products."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import uuid

from basic_memory_projection import canonical_json, digest, render_projection
from memory_paths import MemoryError, corpus_allowed, project_root, require, safe_path, safe_read_bytes

TERMINAL = {"complete", "aborted"}


def _files(root, relative):
    directory = safe_path(root, relative, must_exist=False, kind="dir")
    if not directory.exists():
        return {}
    result = {}
    for candidate in sorted(directory.rglob("*")):
        rel = candidate.relative_to(root).as_posix()
        safe_path(root, rel, kind="any")
        if candidate.is_file():
            result[candidate.relative_to(directory).as_posix()] = digest(safe_read_bytes(root, rel))
    return result


def _classified(root, config):
    """Unknown state is never silently deleted, replaced, or adopted."""
    result = {}
    for kind in ("projection", "index", "normalized", "backend_config"):
        rel = config["state"][kind]
        current = _files(root, rel)
        directory = safe_path(root, rel, must_exist=False, kind="dir")
        require(not directory.exists() or not any(p.is_dir() for p in directory.iterdir()),
                "unclassified_state", "Unexpected nested state directories cannot be replaced.")
        if current and kind == "projection":
            require("manifest.json" in current, "unclassified_state", "Projection ownership manifest is absent.")
            manifest = json.loads(safe_read_bytes(root, rel + "/manifest.json"))
            expected = {e["projection_path"]: e["projection_sha256"] for e in manifest.get("entries", [])}
            require(manifest.get("classification") == "rebuildable-projection" and
                    {k: v for k, v in current.items() if k != "manifest.json"} == expected,
                    "unclassified_state", "Projection contains unknown or modified content.")
        elif current and kind == "index":
            require("manifest.json" in current, "unclassified_state", "Index ownership manifest is absent.")
            manifest = json.loads(safe_read_bytes(root, rel + "/manifest.json"))
            require(manifest.get("classification") == "rebuildable-index" and
                    {k: v for k, v in current.items() if k != "manifest.json"} == manifest.get("files"),
                    "unclassified_state", "Index contains unknown or modified content.")
        elif current and kind == "normalized":
            owned = {}
            receipts = safe_path(root, config["state"]["maintenance"], must_exist=False, kind="dir")
            if receipts.exists():
                for receipt in receipts.glob("backend-*.json"):
                    journal = json.loads(safe_read_bytes(root, receipt.relative_to(root).as_posix()))
                    if journal.get("operation") == "reindex" and journal.get("status") == "complete":
                        for product in journal.get("normalization", {}).get("products", []):
                            owned.setdefault(product["path"], set()).add(product["sha256"])
            for name in current:
                require(Path(name).name == name and name.endswith(".json"), "unclassified_state", "Unknown normalization artifact.")
                product = json.loads(safe_read_bytes(root, rel + "/" + name))
                require(set(product) == {"schema_version", "normalization_version", "document"} and
                        product["schema_version"] == 1 and product["document"].get("kind") == "source",
                        "unclassified_state", "Sole-copy or unclassified normalization content cannot be replaced.")
                doc = product["document"]
                require({"path", "sha256", "source_identity", "extractor", "segments", "kind", "format", "limitations"} <= set(doc)
                        and isinstance(doc["path"], str) and corpus_allowed(doc["path"], config)
                        and name == digest(doc["path"].encode()) + ".json"
                        and isinstance(doc["sha256"], str) and re.fullmatch("[a-f0-9]{64}", doc["sha256"])
                        and isinstance(doc["extractor"], str) and doc["extractor"]
                        and isinstance(doc["source_identity"], str) and doc["source_identity"]
                        and isinstance(doc["segments"], list)
                        and all(isinstance(s, dict) and {"text", "locator", "heading"} <= set(s) for s in doc["segments"])
                        and current[name] in owned.get(rel + "/" + name, set()),
                        "unclassified_state", "Normalization lacks exact path, provenance or completed maintenance ownership.")
        elif kind == "backend_config":
            require(set(current) <= {"config.json", "certification.json"}, "unclassified_state", "Unknown durable backend configuration must be preserved.")
            if "config.json" in current:
                value = json.loads(safe_read_bytes(root, rel + "/config.json"))
                require(set(value) == {"profile_id", "profile_sha256", "project_id", "project_path", "controls", "routing", "mcp_registered"}
                        and value["profile_id"] == "basic-memory-v0.23.0"
                        and value["project_id"] == config["project"]["id"]
                        and value["project_path"] == config["state"]["projection"]
                        and value["routing"] == "local" and value["mcp_registered"] is False,
                        "unclassified_state", "Backend configuration is not an attributable local profile.")
        result[kind] = current
    return result


def pending_reindexes(root, config):
    directory = safe_path(root, config["state"]["maintenance"], must_exist=False, kind="dir")
    if not directory.exists():
        return []
    pending = []
    for candidate in sorted(directory.glob("backend-*.json")):
        journal = json.loads(safe_read_bytes(root, candidate.relative_to(root).as_posix()))
        require(journal.get("operation") == "reindex" and journal.get("schema_version") == 1,
                "maintenance_journal", "Unknown backend maintenance journal.")
        if journal.get("status") not in TERMINAL:
            pending.append(journal)
    return pending


def selected_products(root, config):
    """Already built products remain required even when later removed."""
    selected = {name for name in ("projection", "index")
                if safe_path(root, config["state"][name], must_exist=False, kind="dir").exists()}
    certificate = safe_path(root, config["state"]["backend_config"] + "/certification.json", must_exist=False)
    directory = safe_path(root, config["state"]["maintenance"], must_exist=False, kind="dir")
    if certificate.exists():
        selected.update({"projection", "index"})
    if directory.exists():
        from memory_core import decode_json_yaml
        for path in sorted(directory.glob("backend-*.json")):
            journal = decode_json_yaml(safe_read_bytes(root, path.relative_to(root).as_posix()))
            require(journal.get("operation") == "reindex" and journal.get("schema_version") == 1,
                    "maintenance_journal", "Unknown backend maintenance journal.")
            if journal.get("status") != "aborted":
                selected.update({"projection", "index"})
    return selected


def _maintenance_followup(root):
    """Observe final dependencies without acquiring any maintenance authority."""
    from memory_core import health, load_config
    config = load_config(root)
    selected = selected_products(root, config)
    if config["backend"]["enabled"] and config["backend"]["semantic_enabled"]:
        selected.add("backend")
    if not selected:
        return {"status": "not_required", "ready": True, "pending": [], "operational": "not_exercised"}
    assessment = health(root)
    pending = [{"component": name, "status": component["status"],
                "next_operation": component.get("next_operation", "Inspect canonical health diagnostics before scoped maintenance."),
                "error": component.get("error"), "diagnostics": component.get("diagnostics", [])}
               for name, component in assessment.get("components", {}).items() if component.get("ready") is False]
    if assessment.get("error"):
        pending.append({"component": "canonical", "error": assessment["error"], "next_operation": "Inspect current health and exact recovery state."})
    return {"status": "pending" if pending else "static_ready", "ready": not pending,
            "pending": pending, "assessment": assessment["assessment"], "operational": "not_exercised",
            "authority": "Publication grants no reindex, ontology-link refresh, or runtime activation authority."}


def maintenance_followup(root):
    try:
        return _maintenance_followup(root)
    except (MemoryError, OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as exc:
        error = exc.as_dict() if isinstance(exc, MemoryError) else {"code": "maintenance_assessment_failed", "message": "Final dependencies cannot be assessed."}
        return {"status": "pending", "ready": False, "operational": "not_exercised",
                "pending": [{"component": "memory", "error": error,
                             "next_operation": "Inspect current memory health before a separately authorized repair."}]}


def reindex_payload(root, config=None):
    """Return the concrete request to bind into a reindex grant; read-only."""
    from memory_core import load_config
    from memory_search import collect_documents
    from basic_memory_adapter import load_profile
    root = project_root(root)
    current = load_config(root)
    require(config is None or config == current, "config_changed", "Use current memory configuration.")
    config = current
    profile, profile_sha = load_profile(root, config)
    documents, limitations = collect_documents(root, config)
    files, manifest = render_projection(root, config, documents)
    payload = {"schema_version": 1, "operation": "reindex", "project_id": config["project"]["id"],
               "config_sha256": digest(safe_read_bytes(root, "memory.yaml")), "profile_sha256": profile_sha,
               "projection_manifest": manifest,
               "before": _classified(root, config),
               "paths": [config["state"][k] for k in ("projection", "index", "normalized", "backend_config", "maintenance")],
               "limitations": limitations}
    return payload


def _write(root, relative, data):
    from memory_recovery import atomic_replace
    path = safe_path(root, relative, must_exist=False)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    prior = digest(safe_read_bytes(root, relative)) if path.exists() else None
    atomic_replace(root, relative, data, prior)


def verify_build_request(root, config, request):
    """Worker repeats the actual authority and exact staging checks."""
    from memory_publish import authorize
    payload = request.get("payload")
    require(isinstance(payload, dict) and payload.get("operation") == "reindex", "maintenance_request", "Missing concrete reindex request.")
    authorize(root, config, request["grant_file"], "reindex", digest(canonical_json(payload)),
              request["actor"], paths=payload["paths"])
    operation_id = request["operation_id"]
    require(len(operation_id) == 32 and all(c in "0123456789abcdef" for c in operation_id),
            "maintenance_operation", "Invalid maintenance identity.")
    staging = config["state"]["maintenance"] + "/backend-" + operation_id
    require(request["database"] == staging + "/index/basic-memory.db" and
            request["projection_stage"] == staging + "/projection" and
            request["projection_manifest"] == payload["projection_manifest"],
            "maintenance_scope", "Worker may write only its approved backend staging directory.")
    require(payload["config_sha256"] == digest(safe_read_bytes(root, "memory.yaml")),
            "config_changed", "Configuration changed after maintenance approval.")
    for entry in payload["projection_manifest"]["entries"]:
        require(digest(safe_read_bytes(root, entry["path"])) == entry["sha256"],
                "source_changed", "Canonical source changed after maintenance approval.")
    return safe_path(root, staging, kind="dir")


def reindex(root, *, grant_file, actor, expected_payload_sha256, config=None):
    from memory_core import load_config
    from memory_publish import authorize
    from memory_recovery import project_lock
    from memory_search import collect_documents
    from memory_normalization import build_normalized
    from basic_memory_adapter import load_profile, run_worker, _model_directory, _file_digest
    root = project_root(root)
    current = load_config(root)
    require(config is None or config == current, "config_changed", "Use current memory configuration.")
    config = current
    payload = reindex_payload(root, config)
    require(digest(canonical_json(payload)) == expected_payload_sha256,
            "maintenance_request_changed", "Reindex input differs from the reviewed payload.")
    authorize(root, config, grant_file, "reindex", expected_payload_sha256, actor, paths=payload["paths"])
    profile, profile_sha = load_profile(root, config)
    _model_directory(root, config, profile)
    with project_lock(root):
        require(not pending_reindexes(root, config), "maintenance_pending", "An earlier rebuild requires explicit recovery.")
        require(reindex_payload(root, config) == payload, "maintenance_request_changed", "Reindex input changed while acquiring ownership.")
        operation_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
        stage = config["state"]["maintenance"] + "/backend-" + operation_id
        journal_rel = stage + ".json"
        journal = {"schema_version": 1, "operation": "reindex", "operation_id": operation_id,
                   "project_id": config["project"]["id"], "status": "preparing", "payload": payload,
                   "payload_sha256": expected_payload_sha256, "actor": actor, "effects": []}
        _write(root, journal_rel, canonical_json(journal))
        try:
            documents, limitations = collect_documents(root, config)
            files, manifest = render_projection(root, config, documents)
            require(manifest == payload["projection_manifest"], "source_changed", "Projection inputs changed.")
            for name, raw in files.items():
                _write(root, stage + "/projection/" + name, raw)
            _write(root, stage + "/projection/manifest.json", canonical_json(manifest))
            safe_path(root, stage + "/index", must_exist=False, kind="dir").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
            journal["status"] = "building"
            _write(root, journal_rel, canonical_json(journal))
            request = {"root": str(root), "operation": "reindex", "operation_id": operation_id,
                       "profile_sha256": profile_sha, "payload": payload, "grant_file": grant_file, "actor": actor,
                       "projection_manifest": manifest, "projection_stage": stage + "/projection",
                       "database": stage + "/index/basic-memory.db"}
            result = run_worker(root, config, request, build=True)
            db_hash = _file_digest(safe_path(root, request["database"]))
            _write(root, stage + "/index/manifest.json", canonical_json({"classification": "rebuildable-index", "files": {"basic-memory.db": db_hash}}))
            require(reindex_payload(root, config) == payload, "source_changed", "Canonical or existing derived state changed while indexing.")
            journal.update(status="publishing", runtime=result, after={"projection": _files(root, stage + "/projection"),
                                                                         "index": _files(root, stage + "/index")})
            _write(root, journal_rel, canonical_json(journal))
            for kind in ("projection", "index"):
                target = safe_path(root, config["state"][kind], must_exist=False, kind="dir")
                backup = safe_path(root, stage + "/previous-" + kind, must_exist=False, kind="dir")
                if target.exists():
                    os.rename(target, backup)
                os.rename(safe_path(root, stage + "/" + kind, kind="dir"), target)
                journal["effects"].append("replaced_" + kind)
                _write(root, journal_rel, canonical_json(journal))
            settings = {"profile_id": profile["profile_id"], "profile_sha256": profile_sha,
                        "project_id": config["project"]["id"], "project_path": config["state"]["projection"],
                        "controls": profile["controls"], "routing": "local", "mcp_registered": False}
            _write(root, config["state"]["backend_config"] + "/config.json", canonical_json(settings))
            certificate = {"schema_version": 1, "project_id": config["project"]["id"], "project_root": str(root),
                           "profile_sha256": profile_sha, "config_sha256": payload["config_sha256"],
                           "backend_config_sha256": digest(canonical_json(settings)),
                           "projection_sha256": digest(canonical_json(manifest)), "database_sha256": db_hash,
                           "adapter_sha256": _file_digest(Path(__file__).with_name("basic_memory_adapter.py")),
                           "operation_id": operation_id, "certification": "prebuilt-state-only; global compatibility remains a separate pilot decision"}
            _write(root, config["state"]["backend_config"] + "/certification.json", canonical_json(certificate))
            journal["normalization"] = build_normalized(root, config)
            # First close the committed product boundary. Its historical receipt
            # survives a later failed readiness probe or later source change.
            journal.update(status="complete", limitations=limitations)
            _write(root, journal_rel, canonical_json(journal))
            from basic_memory_adapter import health as backend_health
            readiness = backend_health(root, config, level="operational") if config["backend"]["semantic_enabled"] else {
                "available": False, "runtime": {"status": "not_selected"}, "limitations": ["semantic_backend_disabled"]}
            from basic_memory_projection import verify_projection
            try:
                verify_projection(root, config)
                inputs_current = payload["config_sha256"] == digest(safe_read_bytes(root, "memory.yaml"))
            except MemoryError as changed:
                inputs_current = False
                readiness["error"] = changed.as_dict()
            ready = inputs_current and (readiness["available"] or not config["backend"]["semantic_enabled"])
            journal["readiness"] = {"ready": ready, "backend": readiness, "inputs_current": inputs_current,
                                    "boundary": "committed products; operational readiness is a separate observation"}
            _write(root, journal_rel, canonical_json(journal))
            return {"status": "reindexed" if ready else "maintenance_pending", "ready": ready,
                    "operation_id": operation_id, "journal": journal_rel, "committed": True,
                    "projection_documents": len(manifest["entries"]), "runtime": result, "limitations": limitations,
                    "readiness": journal["readiness"],
                    "next_operation": None if ready else "Inspect current health, then authorize a fresh exact reindex or runtime prerequisite repair."}
        except Exception as exc:
            if journal.get("status") == "complete":
                return {"status": "maintenance_pending", "ready": False, "committed": True,
                        "operation_id": operation_id, "journal": journal_rel,
                        "error": {"code": getattr(exc, "code", type(exc).__name__), "message": "Products committed, but final readiness could not be established."},
                        "next_operation": "Inspect the retained complete boundary and current health before any fresh authorized operation."}
            journal.update(status="failed", error={"code": getattr(exc, "code", type(exc).__name__), "message": str(exc)[:1200]})
            _write(root, journal_rel, canonical_json(journal))
            raise


def recover_reindex(root, operation_id, *, grant_file, actor):
    """Abort a pre-publication rebuild, or restore exact prior derived products.

    Partial products and the original failure receipt remain attributable. No
    canonical memory is replayed or deleted and no Task state is changed.
    """
    from memory_core import load_config
    from memory_publish import authorize
    from memory_recovery import project_lock
    root = project_root(root)
    config = load_config(root)
    require(len(operation_id) == 32 and all(c in "0123456789abcdef" for c in operation_id),
            "maintenance_operation", "Invalid maintenance identity.")
    stage = config["state"]["maintenance"] + "/backend-" + operation_id
    rel = stage + ".json"
    journal = json.loads(safe_read_bytes(root, rel))
    require(journal.get("operation_id") == operation_id and journal.get("status") not in TERMINAL,
            "maintenance_operation", "Only a pending exact rebuild can be recovered.")
    authorize(root, config, grant_file, "reindex", journal["payload_sha256"], actor, paths=journal["payload"]["paths"])
    with project_lock(root):
        for kind in ("projection", "index"):
            before = journal["payload"]["before"][kind]
            target_rel = config["state"][kind]
            backup_rel = stage + "/previous-" + kind
            backup = safe_path(root, backup_rel, must_exist=False, kind="dir")
            target = safe_path(root, target_rel, must_exist=False, kind="dir")
            actual = _files(root, target_rel)
            if actual == before and not backup.exists():
                continue
            require(actual == journal.get("after", {}).get(kind) or not target.exists(),
                    "recovery_conflict", "Changed derived state blocks exact recovery.")
            if target.exists():
                os.rename(target, safe_path(root, stage + "/aborted-" + kind, must_exist=False, kind="dir"))
            if before:
                require(backup.exists() and _files(root, backup_rel) == before,
                        "recovery_conflict", "Prior derived products are not intact.")
                os.rename(backup, target)
        # Any certificate from a partial publication may now reference aborted
        # products. Public reads fail closed until a separately authorized rebuild.
        journal["status"] = "aborted"
        journal["recovery_actor"] = actor
        _write(root, rel, canonical_json(journal))
        return {"status": "aborted", "operation_id": operation_id, "journal": rel}


# Optional action guard adapter.  Standalone/core use imports no ontology runtime.
def _ontology_checkpoint(*, targets=True):
    import sys as _sys
    _module = _sys.modules.get("ontology_guards")
    if _module is not None:
        _module.checkpoint(targets=targets)


def _ontology_guard_adapter(function, family, root_argument, target_paths):
    import functools as _functools
    import inspect as _inspect
    @_functools.wraps(function)
    def guarded(*args, **kwargs):
        import importlib.util as _util
        import sys as _sys
        from pathlib import Path as _Path
        arguments = dict(_inspect.signature(function).bind(*args, **kwargs).arguments)
        if root_argument == "@depot":
            selected_root = installed_locations()[0]
        else:
            selected_root = arguments[root_argument]
            if not isinstance(selected_root, (_Path, str)):
                selected_root = getattr(selected_root, "project_root", getattr(selected_root, "root", selected_root))
        selected_root = _Path(selected_root).absolute()
        config_path = selected_root / "ontology-advanced.yaml"
        if not config_path.exists() and not config_path.is_symlink():
            return function(*args, **kwargs)
        if family == "template" and arguments.get("command") == "check":
            return function(*args, **kwargs)
        import json as _json
        import hashlib as _hashlib
        def unique_pairs(pairs):
            value = {}
            for key, item in pairs:
                if key in value:
                    raise ValueError("duplicate guard configuration key")
                value[key] = item
            return value
        try:
            if config_path.is_symlink():
                raise ValueError("symbolic guard configuration")
            config = _json.loads(config_path.read_text(), object_pairs_hook=unique_pairs)
            selected = config.get("profiles", {}).get("guards", {"enabled": False})
            if config.get("schema_version") != 1 or not isinstance(selected, dict) or type(selected.get("enabled")) is not bool:
                raise ValueError("unsupported guard configuration")
        except (OSError, ValueError, AttributeError) as exc:
            raise _ontology_adapter_error("guard_schema", "Guard configuration is unreadable or unsupported.", {}) from exc
        if not selected["enabled"]:
            if set(selected) != {"enabled"}:
                raise _ontology_adapter_error("guard_schema", "Disabled guard configuration has unsupported fields.", {})
            return function(*args, **kwargs)
        script = selected_root / ".agents/skills/ontology/scripts/ontology_guards.py"
        if not script.is_file() or any(parent.is_symlink() for parent in (script, *script.parents)):
            raise _ontology_adapter_error("guard_unavailable", "Enabled guards require their current project-local installed adapter.", {})
        current_sha256 = _hashlib.sha256(script.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        module = _sys.modules.get("ontology_guards")
        if module is not None and (_Path(module.__file__).resolve() != script.resolve()
                or getattr(module, "ENGINE_SOURCE_SHA256", None) != current_sha256):
            raise _ontology_adapter_error("guard_stale", "Loaded guard code differs from this selected project's current installed bytes; use a fresh owning-helper process after reviewed repair.", {})
        if module is None:
            spec = _util.spec_from_file_location("ontology_guards", script)
            module = _util.module_from_spec(spec)
            _sys.modules["ontology_guards"] = module
            _sys.path.insert(0, str(script.parent))
            spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        targets = list(target_paths)
        if family == "setup":
            destination = _Path(arguments["destination"]).absolute()
            try:
                relative = destination.relative_to(selected_root).as_posix()
            except ValueError:
                raise _ontology_adapter_error("guard_scope", "Setup target escapes the selected depot.", {})
            targets.extend([relative + "/control_records/project-setup.json", relative + "/AGENTS.md", relative + "/ROLE.md"])
        try:
            return module.dispatch(lambda: function(*args, **kwargs), family, function.__name__, selected_root, arguments, targets)
        except module.GuardError as exc:
            raise _ontology_adapter_error(exc.code, str(exc), exc.details) from exc
    return guarded


def _ontology_adapter_error(code, message, details):
    return MemoryError(code, message, details)

ONTOLOGY_GUARDED_ACTIONS = ['reindex', 'recover_reindex']
reindex = _ontology_guard_adapter(reindex, 'memory', 'root', ['MEMORY'])
recover_reindex = _ontology_guard_adapter(recover_reindex, 'memory', 'root', ['MEMORY'])

"""Scoped cooperative publication; native receipts are evidence, not OS authentication."""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re

from memory_paths import MemoryError, require, safe_path, safe_read_bytes, relative_path, project_root
from memory_core import (decode_json_yaml, exact, digest, text, timestamp, strings, sha256,
                         json_bytes, load_config, parse_record, validate_record, render_record, reject_sensitive)
from memory_evidence import read_task, validate_publication_evidence


def within(path, prefix):
    return path == prefix or path.startswith(prefix.rstrip("/") + "/")


def _native_receipt(value, actor):
    exact(value, ("tool", "result"))
    require(value["tool"] == "collaboration.list_agents", "native_receipt", "Current native list_agents evidence is required.")
    exact(value["result"], ("agents",))
    require(isinstance(value["result"]["agents"], list), "native_receipt", "Native roster is malformed.")
    seen = set()
    for entry in value["result"]["agents"]:
        exact(entry, ("agent_name", "agent_status"))
        require(isinstance(entry["agent_name"], str) and entry["agent_name"] not in seen,
                "native_receipt", "Native roster identities must be distinct.")
        seen.add(entry["agent_name"])
        if entry["agent_name"] == actor:
            require(entry["agent_status"] == "running", "publisher_not_running", "Publisher is not observed running.")
    require(actor in seen, "publisher_unconfirmed", "Publisher is absent from the native receipt.")


def _task_bindings(root):
    """Read canonical ownership only; never discover Tasks through memory recall."""
    tasks = safe_path(root, "Tasks", must_exist=False, kind="dir")
    if not tasks.exists():
        return []
    bindings = []
    for folder in sorted(tasks.iterdir()):
        if folder.name.startswith("."):
            continue
        if folder.is_symlink():
            raise MemoryError("unsafe_task", "Task ownership contains an unsafe folder.")
        if not folder.is_dir():
            continue
        relative = (folder / "task.json").relative_to(root).as_posix()
        if not (folder / "task.json").exists():
            continue
        state = decode_json_yaml(safe_read_bytes(root, relative, max_bytes=2_000_000))
        orch = state.get("orchestration")
        if orch and orch.get("manager_id") and orch.get("stage") not in {"unassigned", "finished"}:
            # A paused or uncertain manager remains an owner until reconciled.
            assignment = orch.get("assignments", {}).get(orch["manager_id"], {})
            if assignment.get("state") != "revoked":
                bindings.append((relative, state, assignment))
    return bindings


def authorize(root, config, grant_file, operation, payload_sha256, actor, *, paths, now=None):
    root = project_root(root)
    require(config == load_config(root), "config_changed", "Supplied configuration is not the current project configuration.")
    grant = decode_json_yaml(safe_read_bytes(root, str(grant_file), max_bytes=250000))
    exact(grant, ("schema_version", "grant_id", "project_id", "actor_id", "actor_kind", "operation", "payload_sha256", "config_sha256", "scope", "native_receipt", "observed_at", "expires_at", "task", "reviewed_records", "privacy_redaction"))
    require(grant["schema_version"] == 1 and grant["project_id"] == config["project"]["id"], "grant_project", "Grant schema or project identity is incompatible.")
    text(grant["grant_id"]); text(actor)
    require(grant["actor_id"] == actor and grant["actor_kind"] in {"director", "manager"}, "publisher_forbidden", "Grant must name the actual Director or confirmed manager.")
    digest(payload_sha256); digest(grant["payload_sha256"]); digest(grant["config_sha256"])
    require(grant["operation"] == operation and grant["payload_sha256"] == payload_sha256,
            "grant_payload", "Grant is not bound to this exact operation and reviewed payload.")
    require(grant["config_sha256"] == sha256(safe_read_bytes(root, "memory.yaml")), "config_changed", "Configuration changed after grant review.")
    observed, expires = timestamp(grant["observed_at"]), timestamp(grant["expires_at"])
    now = now or datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    require(observed <= now <= expires and 0 < (expires - observed).total_seconds() <= 300,
            "grant_expired", "Publication requires a current native receipt and unexpired bounded grant.")
    _native_receipt(grant["native_receipt"], actor)
    strings(grant["scope"], nonempty=True)
    require(type(grant["privacy_redaction"]) is bool, "invalid_grant", "Privacy-redaction authority must be explicit.")
    for scoped in grant["scope"]:
        relative_path(scoped)
    for path in paths:
        safe_path(root, path, must_exist=False, kind="any")
        require(any(within(path, prefix) for prefix in grant["scope"]), "grant_scope", "Operation path is outside granted scope.")
    require(isinstance(grant["reviewed_records"], list), "invalid_grant", "Expected explicit reviewed record versions.")
    for ref in grant["reviewed_records"]:
        exact(ref, ("path", "sha256", "expected_sha256")); relative_path(ref["path"])
        digest(ref["sha256"]); digest(ref["expected_sha256"], nullable=True)
    if grant["actor_kind"] == "director":
        binding = config["publication"]["director"]
        require(binding is not None and binding["actor_id"] == actor and grant["task"] is None,
                "director_unbound", "Director lacks a current project binding.")
        for ref in binding["authority"]:
            require(sha256(safe_read_bytes(root, ref["path"])) == ref["sha256"], "authority_changed", "Current governing instructions changed after publisher binding.")
        require(all(any(within(p, prefix) for prefix in binding["scope"]) for p in grant["scope"]),
                "director_scope", "Grant exceeds the configured Director scope.")
        for _, state, assignment in _task_bindings(root):
            writes = assignment.get("fit", {}).get("writes", [])
            require(not any(within(p, scope) or within(scope, p) for p in paths for scope in writes),
                    "manager_owns_scope", "An unreconciled Task manager owns an overlapping assignment.")
    else:
        binding = grant["task"]
        exact(binding, ("path", "sha256", "task_id", "execution_id", "generation", "assignment_id"))
        digest(binding["sha256"])
        require(sha256(safe_read_bytes(root, binding["path"], max_bytes=2_000_000)) == binding["sha256"], "task_changed", "Canonical Task changed after review.")
        state, helper = read_task(root, binding["path"])
        orch = state.get("orchestration", {})
        require(state["task_id"] == binding["task_id"] and orch.get("execution_id") == binding["execution_id"] and
                orch.get("generation") == binding["generation"] and orch.get("manager_id") == binding["assignment_id"] and
                orch.get("stage") == "active" and orch.get("writer") == actor,
                "manager_unconfirmed", "Task does not confirm this actor's current manager ownership.")
        assignment = orch.get("assignments", {}).get(binding["assignment_id"], {})
        require(assignment.get("function") == "manager" and assignment.get("state") == "active" and
                assignment.get("generation") == binding["generation"] and assignment.get("native_id") == actor and
                assignment.get("role_reads"), "manager_unconfirmed", "Manager lacks current activation, generation, or role-read evidence.")
        try:
            require(helper.orch.receipt(assignment["native_receipt"], launch=True) == actor, "manager_unconfirmed", "Launch identity differs.")
            helper.orch.role(assignment["role"], root)
        except helper.orch.OrchestrationError as exc:
            raise MemoryError("manager_role_invalid", "Current role or launch provenance failed the installed helper.") from exc
        writes = assignment["fit"]["writes"]
        require(all(any(within(p, prefix) for prefix in writes) for p in paths), "manager_scope", "Manager activation does not grant this memory write scope.")
    grant["_path"] = str(grant_file)
    grant["_sha256"] = sha256(safe_read_bytes(root, str(grant_file), max_bytes=250000))
    return grant


def transaction_payload(operation_id, operation, changes, reason):
    """Each change contains exact reviewed content; no silent publication rewrite."""
    return {"operation_id": operation_id, "operation": operation, "reason": reason, "changes": changes}


def validate_payload_structure(payload):
    """Validate a request before any semantic or operational authorization check."""
    exact(payload, ("operation_id", "operation", "reason", "changes"))
    require(isinstance(payload["operation_id"], str) and re.fullmatch(r"MEMOP-[A-Za-z0-9-]{4,100}", payload["operation_id"]), "invalid_operation", "Use a stable MEMOP operation identity.")
    require(payload["operation"] in {"publish", "supersede", "retract", "redact"}, "unsupported_operation", "Unsupported canonical operation; schema migrations are not automatic.")
    text(payload["reason"])
    reject_sensitive(payload["reason"])
    require(isinstance(payload["changes"], list) and 1 <= len(payload["changes"]) <= 50, "invalid_changes", "Expected bounded canonical changes.")
    seen = set()
    for change in payload["changes"]:
        exact(change, ("path", "content", "reviewed_record_sha256", "expected_sha256"))
        require(isinstance(change["path"], str) and change["path"] not in seen, "ambiguous_target", "Each memory target must be a unique path.")
        relative_path(change["path"])
        seen.add(change["path"])
        require(isinstance(change["content"], str), "invalid_record", "Memory replacement content must be text.")
        require(isinstance(change["reviewed_record_sha256"], str) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", change["reviewed_record_sha256"]), "invalid_digest", "Reviewed record requires SHA256.")
        require(change["expected_sha256"] is None or isinstance(change["expected_sha256"], str) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", change["expected_sha256"]), "invalid_digest", "Expected record requires SHA256 or explicit absence.")
        parse_record(change["content"])
    return payload


def validate_payload(root, config, payload, grant, *, recovering=False):
    validate_payload_structure(payload)
    paths, records, previous = set(), {}, {}
    existing_ids = {}
    memory_root = safe_path(root, "MEMORY", must_exist=False, kind="dir")
    if memory_root.exists():
        import os
        for directory, dirs, files in os.walk(memory_root, followlinks=False):
            for dirname in dirs:
                safe_path(root, (Path(directory) / dirname).relative_to(root).as_posix(), kind="dir")
            for name in files:
                rel = (Path(directory) / name).relative_to(root).as_posix()
                if rel == "MEMORY/README.md":
                    continue
                require(name.endswith(".md"), "unclassified_memory", "Unclassified canonical content prevents publication.")
                existing = parse_record(safe_read_bytes(root, rel, max_bytes=250000))["metadata"]
                text(existing.get("id"))
                require(existing.get("id") not in existing_ids, "duplicate_identity", "Existing canonical memory has duplicate stable identity.")
                existing_ids[existing.get("id")] = rel
    for change in payload["changes"]:
        exact(change, ("path", "expected_sha256", "content", "reviewed_record_sha256"))
        path = change["path"]
        digest(change["expected_sha256"], nullable=True); digest(change["reviewed_record_sha256"])
        require(isinstance(change["content"], str) and sha256(change["content"]) == change["reviewed_record_sha256"], "reviewed_content_changed", "Record bytes differ from reviewed content.")
        record = validate_record(parse_record(change["content"]), config["project"]["id"])
        meta = record["metadata"]
        require(path.startswith("MEMORY/") and Path(path).name == meta["id"] + ".md" and path not in paths,
                "record_path", "Publication path or duplicate identity is invalid.")
        require(meta["id"] not in records and (meta["id"] not in existing_ids or existing_ids[meta["id"]] == path), "duplicate_identity", "Stable record identity already belongs to another canonical path.")
        paths.add(path); records[meta["id"]] = record
        pub = meta["publication"]
        require(pub is not None and pub["operation_id"] == payload["operation_id"] and
                (recovering or (pub["actor_id"] == grant["actor_id"] and pub["actor_kind"] == grant["actor_kind"])),
                "publication_attribution", "Record publication must attribute the exact reviewed operation and publisher.")
        require({"path": path, "sha256": change["reviewed_record_sha256"], "expected_sha256": change["expected_sha256"]} in grant["reviewed_records"],
                "record_unreviewed", "Grant omits the exact reviewed record and expected version.")
        target = safe_path(root, path, must_exist=False)
        if target.exists():
            old_raw = safe_read_bytes(root, path, max_bytes=250000)
            old_hash = sha256(old_raw)
            require(old_hash == change["expected_sha256"] or (recovering and old_hash == change["reviewed_record_sha256"]),
                    "record_conflict", "Canonical record changed since review.", {"path": path})
            previous[meta["id"]] = parse_record(old_raw)
            old_meta = previous[meta["id"]]["metadata"]
            require(old_meta["id"] == meta["id"] and old_meta["project_id"] == meta["project_id"] and old_meta["created"] == meta["created"],
                    "identity_changed", "Correction cannot replace record identity, owner, or creation chronology.")
            require(timestamp(meta["modified"]) >= timestamp(old_meta["modified"]), "invalid_chronology", "Correction cannot reverse chronology.")
        else:
            require(change["expected_sha256"] is None, "record_conflict", "Expected prior record is absent.")
        if meta["state"] == "active":
            validate_publication_evidence(root, record, config)
    operation = payload["operation"]
    if operation == "publish":
        require(len(records) == 1 and all(r["metadata"]["state"] == "active" for r in records.values()), "invalid_transition", "Publish activates one reviewed record.")
        require(recovering or all(r["metadata"]["state"] == "draft" for r in previous.values()), "invalid_transition", "Correct an active record through supersession or explicit redaction.")
        require(all(not r["metadata"]["lifecycle"]["supersedes"] for r in records.values()), "invalid_transition", "Linked successors require a complete supersession transaction.")
    elif operation == "supersede":
        new = [r for r in records.values() if r["metadata"]["state"] == "active"]
        old = [r for r in records.values() if r["metadata"]["state"] == "superseded"]
        require(len(new) == 1 and old and len(new) + len(old) == len(records), "invalid_transition", "Supersession needs one active successor and its historical predecessors.")
        successor = new[0]["metadata"]
        require(set(successor["lifecycle"]["supersedes"]) == {r["metadata"]["id"] for r in old}, "invalid_transition", "Successor must name every predecessor.")
        for old_record in old:
            meta = old_record["metadata"]
            require(meta["id"] in previous and meta["lifecycle"]["superseded_by"] == successor["id"] and meta["lifecycle"]["reason"] == payload["reason"], "invalid_transition", "Every predecessor must retain its successor and correction reason.")
            require(recovering or previous[meta["id"]]["metadata"]["state"] == "active", "invalid_transition", "Only active predecessors can be superseded.")
            require(old_record["body"] == previous[meta["id"]]["body"], "history_changed", "Supersession retains the predecessor body.")
            protected = set(meta) - {"state", "modified", "lifecycle", "publication"}
            require(all(meta[key] == previous[meta["id"]]["metadata"][key] for key in protected), "history_changed", "Supersession retains predecessor claims and provenance.")
    elif operation == "retract":
        require(len(records) == 1 and len(previous) == 1, "invalid_transition", "Retraction requires one existing record.")
        record = next(iter(records.values())); meta = record["metadata"]
        require(meta["state"] == "retracted" and meta["lifecycle"]["reason"] == payload["reason"] and record["body"] == previous[meta["id"]]["body"], "invalid_transition", "Retraction retains original content and its explicit reason.")
        require(recovering or previous[meta["id"]]["metadata"]["state"] == "active", "invalid_transition", "Only active records can be retracted.")
        protected = set(meta) - {"state", "modified", "lifecycle", "publication"}
        require(all(meta[key] == previous[meta["id"]]["metadata"][key] for key in protected), "history_changed", "Retraction retains the original claim and provenance.")
    else:
        require(grant["privacy_redaction"] and len(records) == len(previous), "redaction_authority", "Redaction requires explicit scoped privacy authority for existing records.")
        require(all(r["metadata"]["lifecycle"]["reason"] == payload["reason"] for r in records.values()), "redaction_reason", "Every redacted record must retain the correction reason.")
    return records


def publish(root, payload, grant_file, actor, *, fault=None):
    from memory_recovery import transact
    committed = transact(root, payload, grant_file, actor, fault=fault)
    from memory_maintenance import maintenance_followup
    return {**committed, "current_readiness": maintenance_followup(root)}


supersede = publish

def propose(root, record, *, output=None, grant_file=None, actor=None):
    config = load_config(root)
    validate_record(record, config["project"]["id"])
    require(record["metadata"]["state"] == "draft", "proposal_state", "Proposals must remain draft.")
    content = render_record(record)
    if output is None:
        return {"operation": "propose", "state": "draft", "content": content, "sha256": sha256(content), "written": False}
    require(grant_file is not None and actor is not None and not str(output).startswith(("MEMORY/", ".sys4ai/")), "proposal_scope", "Saving a proposal requires a bounded evidence-output grant.")
    payload = {"output": str(output), "sha256": sha256(content)}
    authorize(root, config, grant_file, "propose", sha256(json_bytes(payload)), actor, paths=[str(output)])

    with project_lock(root):

# Optional action guard adapter.  Standalone/core use imports no ontology runtime.
def _ontology_checkpoint(*, targets=True):

def _ontology_guard_adapter(function, family, root_argument, target_paths):
    import functools as _functools
    import inspect as _inspect
    @_functools.wraps(function)
    def guarded(*args, **kwargs):
        import importlib.util as _util
        import sys as _sys
        from pathlib import Path as _Path
        arguments = dict(_inspect.signature(function).bind(*args, **kwargs).arguments)
        if root_argument == "@depot":
            selected_root = installed_locations()[0]
        else:
            selected_root = arguments[root_argument]
            if not isinstance(selected_root, (_Path, str)):
                selected_root = getattr(selected_root, "project_root", getattr(selected_root, "root", selected_root))
        selected_root = _Path(selected_root).absolute()
        config_path = selected_root / "ontology-advanced.yaml"
        if not config_path.exists() and not config_path.is_symlink():
            return function(*args, **kwargs)
        if family == "template" and arguments.get("command") == "check":
            return function(*args, **kwargs)
        import json as _json
        import hashlib as _hashlib
        def unique_pairs(pairs):
            value = {}
            for key, item in pairs:
                if key in value:
                    raise ValueError("duplicate guard configuration key")
                value[key] = item
            return value
        try:
            if config_path.is_symlink():
                raise ValueError("symbolic guard configuration")
            config = _json.loads(config_path.read_text(), object_pairs_hook=unique_pairs)
            selected = config.get("profiles", {}).get("guards", {"enabled": False})
            if config.get("schema_version") != 1 or not isinstance(selected, dict) or type(selected.get("enabled")) is not bool:
                raise ValueError("unsupported guard configuration")
        except (OSError, ValueError, AttributeError) as exc:
            raise _ontology_adapter_error("guard_schema", "Guard configuration is unreadable or unsupported.", {}) from exc
        if not selected["enabled"]:
            if set(selected) != {"enabled"}:
                raise _ontology_adapter_error("guard_schema", "Disabled guard configuration has unsupported fields.", {})
            return function(*args, **kwargs)
        script = selected_root / ".agents/skills/ontology/scripts/ontology_guards.py"
        if not script.is_file() or any(parent.is_symlink() for parent in (script, *script.parents)):
            raise _ontology_adapter_error("guard_unavailable", "Enabled guards require their current project-local installed adapter.", {})
        current_sha256 = _hashlib.sha256(script.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        module = _sys.modules.get("ontology_guards")
        if module is not None and (_Path(module.__file__).resolve() != script.resolve()
                or getattr(module, "ENGINE_SOURCE_SHA256", None) != current_sha256):
            raise _ontology_adapter_error("guard_stale", "Loaded guard code differs from this selected project's current installed bytes; use a fresh owning-helper process after reviewed repair.", {})
        if module is None:
            spec = _util.spec_from_file_location("ontology_guards", script)
            module = _util.module_from_spec(spec)
            _sys.modules["ontology_guards"] = module
            _sys.path.insert(0, str(script.parent))
            spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        targets = list(target_paths)
        if family == "setup":
            destination = _Path(arguments["destination"]).absolute()
            try:
                relative = destination.relative_to(selected_root).as_posix()
            except ValueError:
                raise _ontology_adapter_error("guard_scope", "Setup target escapes the selected depot.", {})
            targets.extend([relative + "/control_records/project-setup.json", relative + "/AGENTS.md", relative + "/ROLE.md"])
        try:
            return module.dispatch(lambda: function(*args, **kwargs), family, function.__name__, selected_root, arguments, targets)
        except module.GuardError as exc:
            raise _ontology_adapter_error(exc.code, str(exc), exc.details) from exc
    return guarded


def _ontology_adapter_error(code, message, details):
    return MemoryError(code, message, details)

"""Fixed, local Basic Memory queries over a verified disposable projection.

No vendor CLI, MCP tool, server startup, project discovery, sync, or publication
is exposed. The SQLite and Python checks are application controls, not an OS
sandbox. Every public result is reconstructed from current canonical documents.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
import os
import stat
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, quote, unquote, urlsplit

from basic_memory_projection import canonical_json, digest, verify_projection
from memory_paths import MemoryError, project_root, require, safe_path, safe_read_bytes

PROFILE = "basic-memory-v0.23.0"
VERSION = "0.23.0"
OPERATIONS = ("search", "health")
MODES = ("text", "vector", "hybrid")


def _limitations(error):
    code = getattr(error, "code", "backend_unavailable")
    if code == "file_absent":
        return [code, "A required backend profile, certificate, projection, or index file is absent; explicit setup or reindex is required."]
    if isinstance(error, FileNotFoundError):
        return ["backend_model_absent", "A pinned local model artifact is absent; reads do not download or repair it."]
    return [code]


def _config(root, supplied):
    from memory_core import load_config
    current = load_config(root)
    require(supplied is None or supplied == current, "backend_config_changed", "Use the current project configuration.")
    return current


def load_profile(root, config):
    raw = safe_read_bytes(root, config["contract_root"] + "/profiles/" + PROFILE + ".json")
    value = json.loads(raw)
    require(value.get("profile_id") == PROFILE and value.get("backend_version") == VERSION,
            "backend_profile", "Unsupported Basic Memory profile.")
    require(value.get("query_contract", {}).get("operations") == list(OPERATIONS),
            "backend_operations", "Backend writer operations are prohibited.")
    return value, digest(raw)


def _file_digest(path):
    value = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            value.update(block)
    return value.hexdigest()


def _model_directory(root, config, profile):
    model = profile["model"]
    rel = config["state"]["model_cache"] + "/" + model["revision"]
    directory = safe_path(root, rel, kind="dir")
    for artifact in model["files"]:
        # Tokenizer artifact names contain "tokens" but are immutable model data,
        # not candidate source/credential paths. Only the pinned direct children
        # of the already confined model directory enter this narrow exception.
        require(Path(artifact["path"]).name == artifact["path"], "backend_model_path", "Model artifact must be a direct child.")
        target = directory / artifact["path"]
        info = target.lstat()
        require(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_nlink == 1,
                "backend_model_path", "Model artifacts must be regular, unlinked files.")
        require(target.stat().st_size == artifact["bytes"] and _file_digest(target) == artifact["sha256"],
                "backend_model_changed", "Pinned local model artifact is missing or changed.")
    require({p.name for p in directory.iterdir()} == {a["path"] for a in model["files"]},
            "backend_model_changed", "Unclassified model files are present.")
    return directory


def _read_certificate(root, config, *, documents=None):
    from memory_maintenance import pending_reindexes
    require(not pending_reindexes(root, config), "maintenance_pending", "Backend rebuild recovery is pending.")
    profile, profile_sha = load_profile(root, config)
    rel = config["state"]["backend_config"] + "/certification.json"
    certificate = json.loads(safe_read_bytes(root, rel))
    require(certificate.get("schema_version") == 1 and certificate.get("project_id") == config["project"]["id"]
            and certificate.get("project_root") == str(root), "backend_project", "Backend certificate belongs to another project.")
    require(certificate.get("profile_sha256") == profile_sha, "backend_profile_changed", "Pinned backend profile changed.")
    require(certificate.get("adapter_sha256") == _file_digest(Path(__file__)),
            "backend_adapter_changed", "Query implementation changed after backend certification.")
    require(certificate.get("config_sha256") == digest(safe_read_bytes(root, "memory.yaml")),
            "backend_config_changed", "Backend certificate configuration is stale.")
    require(certificate.get("backend_config_sha256") == digest(safe_read_bytes(root, config["state"]["backend_config"] + "/config.json")),
            "backend_config_changed", "Effective backend configuration changed.")
    projection = verify_projection(root, config, current_documents=documents)
    require(certificate.get("projection_sha256") == digest(safe_read_bytes(root, config["state"]["projection"] + "/manifest.json")),
            "backend_projection_changed", "Backend certificate projection changed.")
    db = safe_path(root, config["state"]["index"] + "/basic-memory.db")
    require(_file_digest(db) == certificate.get("database_sha256"), "backend_database_changed", "Backend database is stale or changed.")
    index = safe_path(root, config["state"]["index"], kind="dir")
    require({p.name for p in index.iterdir()} == {"basic-memory.db", "manifest.json"},
            "unclassified_index", "Unclassified or active database products prevent read-only queries.")
    manifest = json.loads(safe_read_bytes(root, config["state"]["index"] + "/manifest.json"))
    require(manifest == {"classification": "rebuildable-index", "files": {"basic-memory.db": certificate["database_sha256"]}},
            "backend_index_manifest", "Index ownership manifest changed.")
    _model_directory(root, config, profile)
    return profile, certificate, projection


def health(root, config=None):
    """Inspect existing state only. Never import or start the vendor runtime."""
    root = project_root(root)
    try:
        config = _config(root, config)
        if not config["backend"]["enabled"] or not config["backend"]["semantic_enabled"]:
            return {"available": False, "mode": "lexical", "limitations": ["backend_disabled"]}
        profile, certificate, projection = _read_certificate(root, config)
        return {"available": True, "mode": "prebuilt-profile", "profile": profile["profile_id"],
                "documents": len(projection["entries"]), "limitations": ["runtime_not_started_by_health"]}
    except (MemoryError, OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as exc:
        return {"available": False, "mode": "lexical", "limitations": _limitations(exc)}


def _runtime_python(root):
    try:
        if importlib.metadata.version("basic-memory") == VERSION:
            return sys.executable
    except importlib.metadata.PackageNotFoundError:
        pass
    executable = root / ".venv-memory-pilot/bin/python"
    require(executable.is_file(), "backend_runtime_absent", "Pinned local pilot runtime is not installed.")
    return str(executable)


def _worker_environment(root, config):
    # Do not inherit API keys, backend overrides, cloud routing, Python startup
    # customization, or a caller's Hugging Face configuration.
    env = {key: os.environ[key] for key in ("PATH", "LANG", "LC_ALL", "SYSTEMROOT", "TMPDIR") if key in os.environ}
    env.update({"PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "PYTHONNOUSERSITE": "1", "HF_HUB_OFFLINE": "1",
                "HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY": "1", "TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM": "false",
                "BASIC_MEMORY_CONFIG_DIR": str(root / config["state"]["backend_config"]),
                "BASIC_MEMORY_MCP_PROJECT": config["project"]["id"], "BASIC_MEMORY_AUTO_UPDATE": "false",
                "BASIC_MEMORY_ENSURE_FRONTMATTER_ON_SYNC": "false"})
    return env


def run_worker(root, config, request, *, build=False):
    """Fixed program and JSON input only; callers cannot supply commands/tools."""
    started = time.perf_counter()
    proc = subprocess.run([_runtime_python(root), "-B", str(Path(__file__).resolve()),
                           "--build-worker" if build else "--query-worker"],
                          input=canonical_json(request), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                          cwd=root, env=_worker_environment(root, config), timeout=180 if build else 60,
                          check=False)
    require(len(proc.stdout) <= 2_000_000, "backend_output_limit", "Backend response exceeded the result limit.")
    try:
        value = json.loads(proc.stdout)
    except (ValueError, UnicodeError) as exc:
        raise MemoryError("backend_failed", "Backend did not return a valid fixed-operation result.",
                          {"returncode": proc.returncode, "stderr_tail": proc.stderr.decode(errors="replace")[-1500:]}) from exc
    require(proc.returncode == 0 and value.get("ok") is True, value.get("error", "backend_failed"),
            "Pinned backend operation failed.", {"error_detail": value.get("detail"), "returncode": proc.returncode})
    value["subprocess_seconds"] = round(time.perf_counter() - started, 6)
    return value


def query(root, query, config=None, *, mode="hybrid", limit=20, packet=None, pilot=False):
    root = project_root(root)
    require(mode in MODES and isinstance(query, str) and 0 < len(query.strip()) <= 4096 and
            isinstance(limit, int) and not isinstance(limit, bool) and 1 <= limit <= 200 and type(pilot) is bool,
            "backend_query", "Expected a bounded text query and supported retrieval mode.")
    try:
        config = _config(root, config)
        if not pilot and (not config["backend"]["enabled"] or not config["backend"]["semantic_enabled"]):
            return {"available": False, "mode": "lexical", "results": [], "limitations": ["backend_disabled"]}
        from memory_search import collect_documents
        documents, limitations = collect_documents(root, config, historical=False)
        profile, certificate, projection = _read_certificate(root, config, documents=documents)
        if packet is not None:
            from memory_packet import filter_documents
            documents = filter_documents(root, config, documents, packet)
        request = {"root": str(root), "operation": "search", "query": query.strip(), "mode": mode,
                   "limit": limit, "profile_sha256": certificate["profile_sha256"]}
        response = run_worker(root, config, request)
        # Ranking cannot confer scope, lifecycle, metadata, body, or title authority.
        current = {(d["kind"], d["path"]): d for d in documents}
        allowed = {e["projection_path"]: e for e in projection["entries"]}
        results, seen = [], set()
        for row in response["results"]:
            entry = allowed.get(row.get("projection_path"))
            if entry is None or row.get("project_id") != 1:
                continue
            document = current.get((entry["kind"], entry["path"]))
            if document is None or digest(safe_read_bytes(root, entry["path"])) != entry["sha256"]:
                continue
            key = (entry["kind"], entry["source_identity"])
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            results.append({"path": entry["path"], "sha256": entry["sha256"], "kind": entry["kind"],
                            "source_identity": entry["source_identity"], "score": row.get("score"),
                            "retrieval_mode": mode})
        return {"available": True, "mode": mode, "results": results[:limit], "limitations": limitations,
                "runtime": {k: v for k, v in response.items() if k not in {"results", "ok"}}}
    except (MemoryError, OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, ImportError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as exc:
        return {"available": False, "mode": "lexical", "results": [],
                "limitations": _limitations(exc)}


def _sqlite_uri(database):
    return "file:" + quote(str(database), safe="/:")


def _audit_guard(write_root=None, *, database=None):
    """Deny network and Python-level writes beyond an optional staging directory."""
    write_root = Path(write_root).resolve() if write_root else None

    def may_write(value):
        if isinstance(value, int):
            return False
        try:
            target = Path(value).absolute()
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return False
        return write_root is not None and (target == write_root or write_root in target.parents)

    def audit(event, args):
        if event in {"socket.connect", "socket.getaddrinfo", "socket.bind", "socket.sendto", "subprocess.Popen", "os.system"}:
            raise PermissionError("backend_network_or_process_denied:" + event)
        if event == "sqlite3.connect":
            value = args[0]
            if database is None or not isinstance(value, str):
                raise PermissionError("backend_database_denied:unbound_connection")
            if write_root is not None:
                permitted = value == str(database) and may_write(value)
            else:
                parsed = urlsplit(value)
                permitted = (parsed.scheme == "file" and not parsed.netloc and not parsed.fragment
                             and unquote(parsed.path) == str(database)
                             and parse_qs(parsed.query) == {"immutable": ["1"], "mode": ["ro"]})
            if not permitted:
                raise PermissionError("backend_database_denied:wrong_path_or_access")
        if event == "open":
            filename, mode, flags = args
            if (flags or 0) & (os.O_WRONLY | os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | os.O_TRUNC | os.O_APPEND):
                if not may_write(filename):
                    raise PermissionError("backend_write_denied:open")
        elif event in {"os.remove", "os.rename", "os.rmdir", "os.chmod", "os.chown", "os.truncate", "os.link", "os.symlink", "os.utime"}:
            if not may_write(args[0]) or (event in {"os.rename", "os.link", "os.symlink"} and not may_write(args[1])):
                raise PermissionError("backend_write_denied:" + event)
        elif event == "os.mkdir" and not Path(args[0]).is_dir() and not may_write(args[0]):
            raise PermissionError("backend_write_denied:mkdir")
    sys.addaudithook(audit)

            manifest = request["projection_manifest"]
            async with engine.begin() as connection:

            async with session_maker() as session:

                await session.commit()
            await repository.init_search_index()
            for number, entry in enumerate(manifest["entries"], start=1):
                projected = safe_read_bytes(root, request["projection_stage"] + "/" + entry["projection_path"])
                require(digest(projected) == entry["projection_sha256"], "projection_changed", "Staged projection changed.")
                content = projected.decode().split("\n---\n", 1)[1].strip()
                created, modified = datetime.fromisoformat(entry["created"]), datetime.fromisoformat(entry["modified"])
                async with session_maker() as session:
                    session.add(Entity(id=number, project_id=1, title=entry["title"], note_type="note",
                                       entity_metadata={"sys4ai_metadata": entry["metadata"]},
                                       content_type="text/markdown", permalink=entry["permalink"],

            async with session_maker() as session:
                counts = (await session.execute(text("SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT entity_id) FROM search_vector_chunks WHERE project_id=1 AND embedding_status='ready'"))).one()
            require(counts[1] == len(manifest["entries"]), "backend_vector_coverage", "Not every projected document has ready semantic vectors.")
            result = {"indexed_documents": len(manifest["entries"]), "ready_vector_chunks": counts[0], "vector_entities": counts[1]}
        else:
            async with session_maker() as session:
                projects = (await session.execute(text("SELECT id,name,path FROM project"))).all()
                require(len(projects) == 1 and tuple(projects[0]) == (1, config["project"]["id"], str(projection_dir)),

                counts = (await session.execute(text("SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT entity_id) FROM search_vector_chunks WHERE project_id=1 AND embedding_status='ready'"))).one()
                entity_count = (await session.execute(text("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM entity WHERE project_id=1"))).scalar()
                require(counts[1] == entity_count, "backend_vector_coverage", "Semantic coverage is incomplete; reindex requires explicit maintenance.")
            mode = SearchRetrievalMode.FTS if request["mode"] == "text" else SearchRetrievalMode(request["mode"])

    try:

        build = sys.argv[1] == "--build-worker"

"""A disposable Basic Memory representation; canonical bytes never round-trip."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from memory_paths import MemoryError, corpus_allowed, require, safe_path, safe_read_bytes

VERSION = 1
NEUTRAL_SOURCE_TIME = "1970-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"


def digest(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()


def canonical_json(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n").encode()


def _eligible(root, config, document):
    kind, rel = document.get("kind"), document.get("path")
    require(kind in {"source", "memory"}, "projection_kind", "Only source and memory documents can be projected.")
    if kind == "source":
        require(corpus_allowed(rel, config), "projection_scope", "Source is outside the allowed corpus.")
    else:
        from memory_core import load_record
        record = load_record(root, rel, config)
        require(record["metadata"]["state"] == "active", "projection_lifecycle", "Only active memories can be projected.")
        require(record["metadata"] == document.get("metadata"), "projection_metadata", "Canonical memory metadata changed.")
    raw = safe_read_bytes(root, rel)
    require(digest(raw) == document.get("sha256"), "projection_stale", "Canonical document changed before projection.")
    return raw


def render_projection(root, config, documents):
    """Return exact projection files and manifest in memory, without writes."""
    files, entries = {}, []
    for document in sorted(documents, key=lambda d: (d["kind"], d["path"])):
        _eligible(root, config, document)
        require(isinstance(document.get("source_identity"), str) and document["source_identity"],
                "projection_identity", "Each document needs an explicit source identity.")
        metadata = document.get("metadata") or {}
        # Only canonical timestamps govern a curated record. Source mtime is not
        # interpreted as an approval date; unknown chronology stays neutral.
        created = metadata.get("created", NEUTRAL_SOURCE_TIME)
        modified = metadata.get("modified", created)
        identity = digest(canonical_json({"project": config["project"]["id"],
                                          "kind": document["kind"], "path": document["path"]}))
        filename = identity + ".md"
        title = metadata.get("title") or document["path"]
        frontmatter = {
            "title": title, "type": "note", "permalink": "sys4ai/" + identity,
            "created": created, "modified": modified,
            "sys4ai_kind": document["kind"], "sys4ai_project": config["project"]["id"],
            "sys4ai_path": document["path"], "sys4ai_sha256": document["sha256"],
            "sys4ai_source_identity": document["source_identity"],
            "sys4ai_metadata": metadata,
        }
        segments = document.get("segments", [])
        require(isinstance(segments, list) and all(isinstance(s.get("text"), str) for s in segments),
                "projection_segments", "Projection requires normalized text segments.")
        text = "\n\n".join(s["text"] for s in segments)
        raw = b"---\n" + canonical_json(frontmatter) + b"---\n\n" + text.encode() + b"\n"
        files[filename] = raw
        entries.append({"projection_path": filename, "projection_sha256": digest(raw),
                        "path": document["path"], "sha256": document["sha256"],
                        "kind": document["kind"], "source_identity": document["source_identity"],
                        "metadata": metadata, "created": created, "modified": modified,
                        "title": title, "permalink": frontmatter["permalink"],
                        "segments": [{k: v for k, v in s.items() if k != "text"} for s in segments],
                        "limitations": document.get("limitations", [])})
    manifest = {"schema_version": VERSION, "project_id": config["project"]["id"],
                "config_sha256": digest(safe_read_bytes(root, "memory.yaml")),
                "entries": entries, "classification": "rebuildable-projection"}
    return files, manifest


def verify_projection(root, config, manifest=None, *, current_documents=None):
    """Read-only verification of every projected byte and its canonical source."""
    rel = config["state"]["projection"]
    raw = safe_read_bytes(root, rel + "/manifest.json")
    stored = json.loads(raw)
    require(manifest is None or manifest == stored, "projection_manifest_changed", "Projection manifest changed.")
    require(stored.get("schema_version") == VERSION and stored.get("classification") == "rebuildable-projection",
            "projection_manifest", "Unsupported projection manifest.")
    require(stored.get("project_id") == config["project"]["id"], "projection_project", "Projection belongs to another project.")
    require(stored.get("config_sha256") == digest(safe_read_bytes(root, "memory.yaml")),
            "projection_config", "Projection configuration is stale.")
    entries = stored.get("entries", [])
    require(isinstance(entries, list), "projection_manifest", "Projection entries must be a list.")
    expected = {"manifest.json"}
    known = {(d["kind"], d["path"]): d for d in current_documents} if current_documents is not None else None
    for entry in entries:
        name = entry.get("projection_path", "")
        require(Path(name).name == name and name.endswith(".md") and name not in expected,
                "projection_manifest", "Invalid or duplicate projection path.")
        expected.add(name)
        require(digest(safe_read_bytes(root, rel + "/" + name)) == entry.get("projection_sha256"),
                "projection_changed", "Backend projection was modified outside maintenance.")
        if entry.get("kind") == "source":
            require(corpus_allowed(entry.get("path"), config), "projection_scope", "Projected source is no longer allowed.")
        elif entry.get("kind") == "memory":
            from memory_core import load_record
            current = load_record(root, entry["path"], config)
            require(current["metadata"]["state"] == "active" and current["metadata"] == entry.get("metadata"),
                    "projection_lifecycle", "Projected memory lifecycle or metadata changed.")
        else:
            raise MemoryError("projection_kind", "Invalid projected document kind.")
        require(digest(safe_read_bytes(root, entry["path"])) == entry.get("sha256"),
                "projection_stale", "A projected canonical document changed.")
        if known is not None:
            current = known.get((entry["kind"], entry["path"]))
            require(current is not None and current["sha256"] == entry["sha256"] and
                    current["source_identity"] == entry["source_identity"],
                    "projection_scope", "Projection contains a document absent from current permitted retrieval.")
    directory = safe_path(root, rel, kind="dir")
    require({p.name for p in directory.iterdir()} == expected, "unclassified_projection",
            "Unknown files or directories block use of the projection.")
    return stored

"""Public memory CLI: explicit roots and lazy operation dispatch."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json

    search.add_argument("--mode", choices=("auto", "lexical", "hybrid"), default="auto")

    proposal.add_argument("--output"); proposal.add_argument("--grant-file", "--grant", dest="grant_file")
    proposal.add_argument("--actor")
    for operation in ("publish", "supersede", "retract", "redact"):
        command = commands.add_parser(operation); command.add_argument("payload")
        command.add_argument("--grant-file", "--grant", dest="grant_file", required=True)
        command.add_argument("--actor", required=True)
    recover = commands.add_parser("recover"); recover.add_argument("journal")
    recover.add_argument("--grant-file", "--grant", dest="grant_file", required=True); recover.add_argument("--actor", required=True)
    commands.add_parser("reindex-payload")
    rebuild = commands.add_parser("reindex")
    rebuild.add_argument("--grant-file", "--grant", dest="grant_file", required=True); rebuild.add_argument("--actor", required=True)
    rebuild.add_argument("--expected-payload-sha256", required=True)
    backend_recover = commands.add_parser("backend-recover")
    backend_recover.add_argument("--operation-id", required=True)
    backend_recover.add_argument("--grant-file", "--grant", dest="grant_file", required=True)
    backend_recover.add_argument("--actor", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        root = project_root(args.project_root)
        if args.command == "health":
            result = health(root)
